flavorText.diamond-pearl: Made from soil, the shell on its back hardens when it drinks water. It lives along lakes.
flavorText.platinum: The shell on its back is made of soil. On a very healthy TURTWIG, the shell should feel moist.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: Photosynthesis occurs across its body under the sun. The shell on its back is actually hardened soil.
flavorText.black-white: The shell on its back is made of soil. On a very healthy Turtwig, the shell should feel moist.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: The shell on its back is made of soil. On a very healthy Turtwig, the shell should feel moist.
flavorText.x-y: Photosynthesis occurs across its body under the sun. The shell on its back is actually hardened soil.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Photosynthesis occurs across its body under the sun. The shell on its back is actually hardened soil.
flavorText.legends-arceus: This Pokémon becomes more energetic the more sunlight there is. The part resembling a shell is similar to silt and is slightly damp and warm to the touch.

flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: A GROTLE that lives in the forest is said to have its own secret springwater.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: It lives along water in forests. In the daytime, it leaves the forest to sunbathe its treed shell.
flavorText.platinum: It knows where pure water wells up. It carries fellow Pokémon there on its back.
flavorText.black-white: It knows where pure water wells up. It carries fellow Pokémon there on its back.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: It knows where pure water wells up. It carries fellow Pokémon there on its back.
flavorText.x-y: It lives along water in forests. In the daytime, it leaves the forest to sunbathe its treed shell.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: It lives along water in forests. In the daytime, it leaves the forest to sunbathe its treed shell.
flavorText.legends-arceus: Appears where there is clean spring water. The fruit that grows on the shrubs on its shell is sweet, nutritious, and truly delicious.

flavorText.black-2-white-2: Some Pokémon are born on a Torterra’s back and spend their entire life there.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: Small Pokémon occasionally gather on its unmoving back to begin building their nests.
flavorText.platinum: Some Pokémon are born on a TORTERRA’s back and spend their entire life there.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: Ancient people imagined that beneath the ground, a gigantic TORTERRA dwelled.
flavorText.black-white: Some Pokémon are born on a Torterra’s back and spend their entire life there.
flavorText.x-y: Ancient people imagined that beneath the ground, a gigantic Torterra dwelled.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Ancient people imagined that beneath the ground, a gigantic Torterra dwelled.
flavorText.legends-arceus: This remarkable, large-bodied Pokémon would serve beautifully as borrowed scenery for a garden, and its strength is peerless. Torterra roams the wilderness in search of clean water.

flavorText.diamond-pearl: It agilely scales sheer cliffs to live atop craggy mountains. Its fire is put out when it sleeps.
flavorText.platinum: It is very agile. Before going to sleep, it extinguishes the flame on its tail to prevent fires.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: The gas made in its belly burns from its rear end. The fire burns weakly when it feels sick.
flavorText.black-white: It is very agile. Before going to sleep, it extinguishes the flame on its tail to prevent fires.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: It is very agile. Before going to sleep, it extinguishes the flame on its tail to prevent fires.
flavorText.x-y: Its fiery rear end is fueled by gas made in its belly. Even rain can’t extinguish the fire.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Its fiery rear end is fueled by gas made in its belly. Even rain can’t extinguish the fire.
flavorText.legends-arceus: Full of vigor and always in high spirits. It was once known by the name ”Lantern-Tail” and feared as some kind of apparition.

flavorText.diamond-pearl: To intimidate attackers, it stretches the fire on its tail to make itself appear bigger.
flavorText.platinum: It skillfully controls the intensity of the fire on its tail to keep its foes at an ideal distance.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: A bigger fire on its tail and a brighter blue pattern on its face means its rank in its pack is higher.
flavorText.black-white: It skillfully controls the intensity of the fire on its tail to keep its foes at an ideal distance.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: It skillfully controls the intensity of the fire on its tail to keep its foes at an ideal distance.
flavorText.x-y: It skillfully controls the intensity of the fire on its tail to keep its foes at an ideal distance.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: It skillfully controls the intensity of the fire on its tail to keep its foes at an ideal distance.
flavorText.legends-arceus: The deeper the blue on its face, the more powerful it will grow to become. It leaps about every which way and lands powerful blows against its opponents with the flame on its tail.

flavorText.diamond-pearl: It uses a special kind of martial arts involving all its limbs. Its fire never goes out.
flavorText.platinum: It uses unique fighting moves with fire on its hands and feet. It will take on any opponent.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: It tosses its enemies around with agility. It uses all its limbs to fight in its own unique style.
flavorText.black-white: It uses unique fighting moves with fire on its hands and feet. It will take on any opponent.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: It uses unique fighting moves with fire on its hands and feet. It will take on any opponent.
flavorText.x-y: Its crown of fire is indicative of its fiery nature. It is beaten by none in terms of quickness.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Its crown of fire is indicative of its fiery nature. It is beaten by none in terms of quickness.
flavorText.legends-arceus: A tall, hardy Pokémon with a dazzling appearance. It shrouds itself in flame and battles as if engaged in dance—truly a sight to behold.

flavorText.diamond-pearl: Because it is very proud, it hates accepting food from people. Its thick down guards it from cold.
flavorText.platinum: A poor walker, it often falls down. However, its strong pride makes it puff up its chest without a care.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: It doesn’t like to be taken care of. It’s difficult to bond with since it won’t listen to its Trainer.
flavorText.black-white: A poor walker, it often falls down. However, its strong pride makes it puff up its chest without a care.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: A poor walker, it often falls down. However, its strong pride makes it puff up its chest without a care.
flavorText.x-y: It doesn’t like to be taken care of. It’s difficult to bond with since it won’t listen to its Trainer.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: It doesn’t like to be taken care of. It’s difficult to bond with since it won’t listen to its Trainer.
flavorText.legends-arceus: Prefers cold climes and appears along coasts. It's an adorable little thing—as cute as any child—but it's also prideful, unwilling to accept handouts from people.

flavorText.diamond-pearl: It lives alone, away from others. Apparently, every one of them believes it is the most important.
flavorText.platinum: Because every PRINPLUP considers itself to be the most important, they can never form a group.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: It lives a solitary life. Its wings deliver wicked blows that can snap even the thickest of trees.
flavorText.black-white: Because every Prinplup considers itself to be the most important, they can never form a group.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: Because every Prinplup considers itself to be the most important, they can never form a group.
flavorText.x-y: It lives alone, away from others. Apparently, every one of them believes it is the most important.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: It lives alone, away from others. Apparently, every one of them believes it is the most important.
flavorText.legends-arceus: It swims gracefully through the frigid sea and sings with a voice like the roaring tide. It has powerful, sturdy wings and dignity to match.

flavorText.diamond-pearl: The three horns that extend from its beak attest to its power. The leader has the biggest horns.
flavorText.platinum: If anyone were to hurt its pride, it would slash them with wings that can cleave through an ice floe.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: It avoids unnecessary disputes, but it will decimate anything that threatens its pride.
flavorText.black-white: If anyone were to hurt its pride, it would slash them with wings that can cleave through an ice floe.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: If anyone were to hurt its pride, it would slash them with wings that can cleave through an ice floe.
flavorText.x-y: It swims as fast as a jet boat. The edges of its wings are sharp and can slice apart drifting ice.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: It swims as fast as a jet boat. The edges of its wings are sharp and can slice apart drifting ice.
flavorText.legends-arceus: Since ancient times, it has been revered by the people of Hisui, who call it the Master of the Waves. Its wings are a match for even master-crafted blades.

flavorText.diamond-pearl: They flock in great numbers. Though small, they flap their wings with great power.
flavorText.platinum: Because they are weak individually, they form groups. However, they bicker if the group grows too big.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: They flock around mountains and fields, chasing after bug Pokémon. Their singing is noisy and annoying.
flavorText.black-white: Because they are weak individually, they form groups. However, they bicker if the group grows too big.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: Because they are weak individually, they form groups. However, they bicker if the group grows too big.
flavorText.x-y: They flock in great numbers. Though small, they flap their wings with great power.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: They flock in great numbers. Though small, they flap their wings with great power.
flavorText.legends-arceus: They live in the fields and mountains, gathering in large flocks. Their cries are quite obnoxious. Though small, their wings are strong—a strike from them leaves pain that persists for a week.

flavorText.diamond-pearl: It flies around forests and fields in search of bug Pokémon. It stays within a huge flock.
flavorText.platinum: Recognizing their own weakness, they always live in a group. When alone, a STARAVIA cries noisily.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: They maintain huge flocks, although fierce scuffles break out between various flocks.
flavorText.black-white: Recognizing their own weakness, they always live in a group. When alone, a Staravia cries noisily.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: Recognizing their own weakness, they always live in a group. When alone, a Staravia cries noisily.
flavorText.x-y: They maintain huge flocks, although fierce scuffles break out between various flocks.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: They maintain huge flocks, although fierce scuffles break out between various flocks.
flavorText.legends-arceus: They form remarkably large flocks and are constantly fighting amongst themselves. I suspect that those with magnificent plumes on their heads are the strong ones.

flavorText.diamond-pearl: It has a savage nature. It will courageously challenge foes that are much larger.
flavorText.platinum: It never stops attacking even if it is injured. It fusses over the shape of its comb.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: When STARAVIA evolve into STARAPTOR, they leave the flock to live alone. They have sturdy wings.
flavorText.black-white: It never stops attacking even if it is injured. It fusses over the shape of its comb.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: It never stops attacking even if it is injured. It fusses over the shape of its comb.
flavorText.x-y: The muscles in its wings and legs are strong. It can easily fly while gripping a small Pokémon.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: The muscles in its wings and legs are strong. It can easily fly while gripping a small Pokémon.
flavorText.legends-arceus: It has left the flock, having gained strength enough to survive on its own. The astounding force with which Staraptor flies through the air allows it to carry away large, burly targets.

flavorText.black-white: A comparison revealed that Bidoof’s front teeth grow at the same rate as Rattata’s.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: With nerves of steel, nothing can perturb it. It is more agile and active than it appears.
flavorText.platinum: A comparison revealed that BIDOOF’s front teeth grow at the same rate as RATTATA’s.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: It lives in groups by the water. It chews up boulders and trees around its nest with its incisors.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: A comparison revealed that Bidoof’s front teeth grow at the same rate as Rattata’s.
flavorText.x-y: With nerves of steel, nothing can perturb it. It is more agile and active than it appears.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: With nerves of steel, nothing can perturb it. It is more agile and active than it appears.
flavorText.legends-arceus: Bidoof has an unsophisticated face and is rarely flustered by anything. There have been incidents involving Bidoof sauntering into villages and gnawing on the houses without a single care.

flavorText.diamond-pearl: It makes its nest by damming streams with bark and mud. It is known as an industrious worker.
flavorText.platinum: A river dammed by BIBAREL will never overflow its banks, which is appreciated by people nearby.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: It busily makes its nest with stacks of branches and roots it has cut up with its sharp incisors.
flavorText.black-white: A river dammed by Bibarel will never overflow its banks, which is appreciated by people nearby.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: A river dammed by Bibarel will never overflow its banks, which is appreciated by people nearby.
flavorText.x-y: It busily makes its nest with stacks of branches and roots it has cut up with its sharp incisors.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: It busily makes its nest with stacks of branches and roots it has cut up with its sharp incisors.
flavorText.legends-arceus: Bibarel fur repels water and is also a fantastic material for heat retention. These Pokémon create dams on rivers to live in.

flavorText.diamond-pearl: It shakes its head back to front, causing its antennae to hit each other and sound like a xylophone.
flavorText.platinum: Its legs are short. Whenever it stumbles, its stiff antennae clack with a xylophone-like sound.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: When its antennae hit each other, it sounds like the music of a xylophone.
flavorText.black-white: Its legs are short. Whenever it stumbles, its stiff antennae clack with a xylophone-like sound.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: Its legs are short. Whenever it stumbles, its stiff antennae clack with a xylophone-like sound.
flavorText.x-y: It chats with others using the sounds of its colliding antennae. These sounds are fall hallmarks.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: It chats with others using the sounds of its colliding antennae. These sounds are fall hallmarks.
flavorText.legends-arceus: When the trees take on new hues, more of these Pokémon appear. The tone they create by striking their antennae together resembles that of the marimba, an instrument of foreign lands.

flavorText.diamond-pearl: It crosses its knifelike arms in front of its chest when it cries. It can compose melodies ad lib.
flavorText.platinum: There is a village that hosts a contest based on the amazingly variable cries of this Pokémon.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: By allowing its cry to resonate in the hollow of its belly, it produces a captivating sound.
flavorText.black-white: There is a village that hosts a contest based on the amazingly variable cries of this Pokémon.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: There is a village that hosts a contest based on the amazingly variable cries of this Pokémon.
flavorText.x-y: It crosses its knifelike arms in front of its chest when it cries. It can compose melodies ad lib.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: It crosses its knifelike arms in front of its chest when it cries. It can compose melodies ad lib.
flavorText.legends-arceus: It uses its cutlass-like arms to produce sound, the melody of which varies from individual to individual. It is a worthwhile endeavor to seek out one's favorite tunes.

flavorText.diamond-pearl: All of its fur dazzles if danger is sensed. It flees while the foe is momentarily blinded.
flavorText.platinum: The extension and contraction of its muscles generates electricity. It glows when in trouble.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: The extension and contraction of its muscles generates electricity. Its fur glows when it’s in trouble.
flavorText.black-white: The extension and contraction of its muscles generates electricity. It glows when in trouble.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: The extension and contraction of its muscles generates electricity. It glows when in trouble.
flavorText.x-y: The extension and contraction of its muscles generates electricity. It glows when in trouble.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: The extension and contraction of its muscles generates electricity. It glows when in trouble.
flavorText.sword-shield: This Pokémon generates electricity by contracting its muscles. Excited trembling is a sign that Shinx is generating a tremendous amount of electricity.
flavorText.legends-arceus: Shakes its body to generate electricity. Its stature belies its aggression—one must be patient to tame this Pokémon.

flavorText.diamond-pearl: Its claws loose electricity with enough amperage to cause fainting. They live in small groups.
flavorText.platinum: Strong electricity courses through the tips of its sharp claws. A light scratch causes fainting in foes.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: By gathering their tails together, they collectively generate powerful electricity from their claws.
flavorText.black-white: Strong electricity courses through the tips of its sharp claws. A light scratch causes fainting in foes.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: Strong electricity courses through the tips of its sharp claws. A light scratch causes fainting in foes.
flavorText.x-y: Its claws loose electricity with enough amperage to cause fainting. They live in small groups.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Its claws loose electricity with enough amperage to cause fainting. They live in small groups.
flavorText.sword-shield: By joining its tail with that of another Luxio, this Pokémon can receive some of the other Luxio’s electricity and power up its own electric blasts.
flavorText.legends-arceus: Proudly uses its electrified claws as weapons. It seems to be a gracious Pokémon, evenly sharing the spoils of the hunt with others of its kind.

flavorText.diamond-pearl: It has eyes that can see through anything. It spots and captures prey hiding behind objects.
flavorText.platinum: It can see clearly through walls to track down its prey and seek its lost young.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: LUXRAY’s ability to see through objects comes in handy when it’s scouting for danger.
flavorText.black-white: It can see clearly through walls to track down its prey and seek its lost young.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: It can see clearly through walls to track down its prey and seek its lost young.
flavorText.x-y: When its eyes gleam gold, it can spot hiding prey--even those taking shelter behind a wall.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: When its eyes gleam gold, it can spot hiding prey—even those taking shelter behind a wall.
flavorText.sword-shield: Luxray can see through solid objects. It will instantly spot prey trying to hide behind walls, even if the walls are thick.
flavorText.legends-arceus: They form packs, each having one male as leader. Legends say that when Luxray's two eyes shimmer with gold, the Pokémon can see through anything.

flavorText.diamond-pearl: Over the winter, it closes its bud and endures the cold. In spring, the bud opens and releases pollen.
flavorText.platinum: Sensitive to changing temperature, the bud is said to bloom when it feels the sun’s warm touch.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: When it feels the sun’s warm touch, it opens its bud to release pollen. It lives alongside clear pools.
flavorText.black-white: Sensitive to changing temperature, the bud is said to bloom when it feels the sun’s warm touch.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: Sensitive to changing temperatures, the bud blooms when it’s warm, releasing toxic pollen.
flavorText.x-y: When it feels the sun’s warm touch, it opens its bud to release pollen. It lives alongside clear pools.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: When it feels the sun’s warm touch, it opens its bud to release pollen. It lives alongside clear pools.
flavorText.sword-shield: The pollen it releases contains poison. If this Pokémon is raised on clean water, the poison’s toxicity is increased.
flavorText.legends-arceus: When the sun's light strengthens, the bud atop this Pokémon's head opens. This is a sign to the people that the harsh winter is over, and the season of budding has begun.

flavorText.diamond-pearl: It attracts prey with a sweet aroma, then downs it with thorny whips hidden in its arms.
flavorText.platinum: Each of its hands contains different toxins, but both hands can jab with near-fatal power.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: Its sweet aroma attracts prey. Then it spews poison. The more toxic it is, the sweeter its aroma.
flavorText.black-white: Each of its hands contains different toxins, but both hands can jab with near-fatal power.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: Luring prey with a sweet scent, it uses poison whips on its arms to poison, bind, and finish off the prey.
flavorText.x-y: Luring prey with a sweet scent, it uses poison whips on its arms to poison, bind, and finish off the prey.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Luring prey with a sweet scent, it uses poison whips on its arms to poison, bind, and finish off the prey.
flavorText.sword-shield: After captivating opponents with its sweet scent, it lashes them with its thorny whips.
flavorText.legends-arceus: Hidden within the bouquet on each hand are thorned whips loaded with virulent poison. Roserade moves gracefully as it corners its prey and mercilessly lashes them with its whips.

flavorText.diamond-pearl: It lived in jungles around 100 million years ago. Its skull is as hard as iron.
flavorText.platinum: A lifelong jungle dweller from 100 million years ago, it would snap obstructing trees with head butts.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: CRANIDOS toughen up their already rock-hard heads by headbutting one another.
flavorText.black-white: A lifelong jungle dweller from 100 million years ago, it would snap obstructing trees with head butts.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: A lifelong jungle dweller from 100 million years ago, it would snap obstructing trees with head butts.
flavorText.x-y: It was resurrected from an iron ball-like fossil. It downs prey with its headbutts.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: It was resurrected from an iron ball-like fossil. It downs prey with its headbutts.
flavorText.sun-moon: It lived in jungles around a hundred million years ago. It used its skillful headbutts to combat Aerodactyl.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: A primeval Pokémon, it possesses a hard and sturdy skull, lacking any intelligence within.
flavorText.legends-arceus: An incredibly rare sight. They duel each other by ramming their heads together, and the resulting sound echoes throughout the area like the pealing of a bell.

flavorText.diamond-pearl: Its powerful head butt has enough power to shatter even the most durable things upon impact.
flavorText.platinum: If two were to smash their heads together, their foot-thick skulls would keep them from fainting.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: Its skull withstands impacts of any magnitude. As a result, its brain never gets the chance to grow.
flavorText.black-white: If two were to smash their heads together, their foot-thick skulls would keep them from fainting.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: If two were to smash their heads together, their foot-thick skulls would keep them from fainting.
flavorText.x-y: Its skull withstands impacts of any magnitude. As a result, its brain never gets the chance to grow.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Its skull withstands impacts of any magnitude. As a result, its brain never gets the chance to grow.
flavorText.sun-moon: The result of repeated headbutts is a skull grown thick and hard. However, its brain has shrunk in size compared with Cranidos’s.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: In ancient times, people would dig up fossils of this Pokémon and use its skull, which is harder than steel, to make helmets.
flavorText.legends-arceus: Very little is known about its biology. Can knock down massive trees by smashing its beautiful, pearl-like crown against them.

flavorText.diamond-pearl: A Pokémon that lived in jungles around 100 million years ago. Its facial hide is extremely hard.
flavorText.platinum: It is outstandingly armored. As a result, it can eat grass and berries without having to fight.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: It was generated from a fossil dug out of a layer of clay that was older than anyone knows. It has a sturdy face.
flavorText.black-white: It is outstandingly armored. As a result, it can eat grass and berries without having to fight.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: It is outstandingly armored. As a result, it can eat grass and berries without having to fight.
flavorText.x-y: It habitually polishes its face by rubbing it against tree trunks. It is weak to attacks from behind.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: It habitually polishes its face by rubbing it against tree trunks. It is weak to attacks from behind.
flavorText.sun-moon: Many fossils of this Pokémon have been found, but almost none have shown signs of damage to the face.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: A mild-mannered, herbivorous Pokémon, it used its face to dig up tree roots to eat. The skin on its face was plenty tough.
flavorText.legends-arceus: Much remains unknown about this Pokémon, as few have ever seen it. However, we know that it is calm and dislikes conflict, and it enjoys polishing its face against trees and rocks.

flavorText.diamond-pearl: Any frontal attack is repulsed. It is a docile Pokémon that feeds on grass and berries.
flavorText.platinum: When they lined up side by side, no foe could break through. They shielded their young in that way.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: When attacked, they form a wall. Their rock-hard faces serve to protect them from the attacks.
flavorText.black-white: When they lined up side by side, no foe could break through. They shielded their young in that way.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: When they lined up side by side, no foe could break through. They shielded their young in that way.
flavorText.x-y: When they lined up side by side, no foe could break through. They shielded their young in that way.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: When they lined up side by side, no foe could break through. They shielded their young in that way.
flavorText.sun-moon: While it can guard against any sort of attack from the front, it is left without recourse when attacked from behind.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: The bones of its face are huge and hard, so they were mistaken for its spine until after this Pokémon was successfully restored.
flavorText.legends-arceus: Its face is sturdy—as strong as diamond—and this hardness offers a very stable defense. Much about this species is still unknown, such as its natural habitat.

flavorText.diamond-pearl: To shelter itself from cold, wintry winds, it covers itself with a cloak made of twigs and leaves.
flavorText.platinum: Even if it is born where there are no cocooning materials, it somehow always ends up with a cloak.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: It covers itself with a cloak to shelter from the cold. When it’s hot, its cloak is thinner.
flavorText.black-white: Even if it is born where there are no cocooning materials, it somehow always ends up with a cloak.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: Even if it is born where there are no cocooning materials, it somehow always ends up with a cloak.
flavorText.x-y: To shelter itself from cold, wintry winds, it covers itself with a cloak made of twigs and leaves.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: To shelter itself from cold, wintry winds, it covers itself with a cloak made of twigs and leaves.
flavorText.legends-arceus: If its cloak is even slightly damaged, Burmy will immediately repair it with whatever is close at hand. The Pokémon within the cloak is scrawny and vulnerable to the cold.

flavorText.diamond-pearl: When BURMY evolved, its cloak became a part of this Pokémon’s body. The cloak is never shed.
flavorText.platinum: When evolving, its body takes in surrounding materials. As a result, there are many body variations.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: It is said that a WORMADAM that evolves on a cold day will have a thicker cloak.
flavorText.black-white: When evolving, its body takes in surrounding materials. As a result, there are many body variations.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: When evolving, its body takes in surrounding materials. As a result, there are many body variations.
flavorText.x-y: Its appearance changes depending on where it evolved. The materials on hand become a part of its body.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Its appearance changes depending on where it evolved. The materials on hand become a part of its body.

flavorText.diamond-pearl: It loves the honey of flowers and steals honey collected by COMBEE.
flavorText.platinum: While it loves floral honey, it won’t gather any itself. Instead, it plots to steal some from COMBEE.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: It flutters around at night and steals honey from the COMBEE hive.
flavorText.black-white: While it loves floral honey, it won’t gather any itself. Instead, it plots to steal some from Combee.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: While it loves floral honey, it won’t gather any itself. Instead, it plots to steal some from Combee.
flavorText.x-y: It loves the honey of flowers and steals honey collected by Combee.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: It loves the honey of flowers and steals honey collected by Combee.
flavorText.legends-arceus: Scatters steel-colored scales as it flaps its wings. Despite being observed feeding primarily on the nectar of flowers, Mothim is not often seen around flower gardens.

flavorText.diamond-pearl: A Pokémon formed by three others. It busily carries sweet floral honey to VESPIQUEN.
flavorText.platinum: The trio is together from birth. It constantly gathers honey from flowers to please VESPIQUEN.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: At night, COMBEE sleep in a group of about a thousand, packed closely together in a lump.
flavorText.black-white: The trio is together from birth. It constantly gathers honey from flowers to please Vespiquen.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: This Pokémon is a set of three. When they sleep, they gather up and form a giant hive of 100 Combee.
flavorText.x-y: The trio is together from birth. It constantly gathers honey from flowers to please Vespiquen.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: The trio is together from birth. It constantly gathers honey from flowers to please Vespiquen.
flavorText.sword-shield: The members of the trio spend all their time together. Each one has a slightly different taste in nectar.
flavorText.legends-arceus: They swear fealty to a queen Pokémon and work diligently to gather nectar. Each swarm produces a different flavor of honey.

flavorText.diamond-pearl: Its abdomen is a honeycomb for grubs. It raises its grubs on honey collected by COMBEE.
flavorText.platinum: It releases various pheromones to make the grubs in its body do its bidding while fighting foes.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: It raises grubs in the holes in its body. It secretes pheromones to control COMBEE.
flavorText.black-white: It releases various pheromones to make the grubs in its body do its bidding while fighting foes.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: It houses its colony in cells in its body and releases various pheromones to make those grubs do its bidding.
flavorText.x-y: It houses its colony in cells in its body and releases various pheromones to make those grubs do its bidding.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: It houses its colony in cells in its body and releases various pheromones to make those grubs do its bidding.
flavorText.sword-shield: It skillfully commands its grubs in battles with its enemies. The grubs are willing to risk their lives to defend Vespiquen.
flavorText.legends-arceus: Commands its subjects to build its hive. It will dispatch any interlopers who dare sneak into its nest and use them as nourishment for itself.

flavorText.diamond-pearl: It makes fur balls that crackle with static electricity. It stores them with berries in tree holes.
flavorText.platinum: A pair may be seen rubbing their cheek pouches together in an effort to share stored electricity.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: It’s one of the kinds of Pokémon with electric cheek pouches. It shoots charges from its tail.
flavorText.black-white: A pair may be seen rubbing their cheek pouches together in an effort to share stored electricity.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: A pair may be seen rubbing their cheek pouches together in an effort to share stored electricity.
flavorText.x-y: It makes fur balls that crackle with static electricity. It stores them with berries in tree holes.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: It makes fur balls that crackle with static electricity. It stores them with berries in tree holes.
flavorText.legends-arceus: A species related to the Pikachu line. Though Pachirisu is a calm Pokémon, it still presents a danger should one touch its electrified tail or cheeks.

flavorText.diamond-pearl: It has a flotation sac that is like an inflatable collar. It floats on water with its head out.
flavorText.platinum: It spins its two tails like a screw to propel itself through water. The tails also slice clinging seaweed.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: It inflates its flotation sac, keeping its face above water in order to watch for prey movement.
flavorText.black-white: It spins its two tails like a screw to propel itself through water. The tails also slice clinging seaweed.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: It inflates the flotation sac around its neck and pokes its head out of the water to see what is going on.
flavorText.x-y: It swims by rotating its two tails like a screw. When it dives, its flotation sac collapses.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: It swims by rotating its two tails like a screw. When it dives, its flotation sac collapses.
flavorText.legends-arceus: It moves freely in the water by spinning its forked tail for propulsion. The resemblance to the screw of a steamboat is coincidental.

flavorText.diamond-pearl: It floats using its well-developed flotation sac. It assists in the rescues of drowning people.
flavorText.platinum: It is a common sight around fishing ports. It is known to rescue people and carry off prey.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: With its flotation sac inflated, it can carry people on its back. It deflates the sac before it dives.
flavorText.black-white: It is a common sight around fishing ports. It is known to rescue people and carry off prey.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: It is a common sight around fishing ports. It is known to rescue people and carry off prey.
flavorText.x-y: It floats using its well-developed flotation sac. It assists in the rescues of drowning people.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: It floats using its well-developed flotation sac. It assists in the rescues of drowning people.
flavorText.legends-arceus: Has a long, rather splendid flotation sac, which prevents Floatzel from drowning even in stormy seas. One might glimpse this species around fishing hamlets from time to time.

flavorText.diamond-pearl: The small ball holds the nutrients needed for evolution. Apparently, it is very sweet and tasty.
flavorText.platinum: The small ball is not only filled with nutrients, it is also tasty. STARLY try to peck it off.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: It evolves by sucking the energy out of the small ball where it had been storing nutrients.
flavorText.black-white: The small ball is not only filled with nutrients, it is also tasty. Starly try to peck it off.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: The small ball is not only filled with nutrients, it is also tasty. Starly try to peck it off.
flavorText.x-y: Sunlight colors it red. When the small ball is drained of nutrients, it shrivels to herald evolution.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Sunlight colors it red. When the small ball is drained of nutrients, it shrivels to herald evolution.
flavorText.sword-shield: It nimbly dashes about to avoid getting pecked by bird Pokémon that would love to make off with its small, nutrient-rich storage ball.
flavorText.legends-arceus: Once the fruit growing alongside the main body is large and plump, Cherubi will use the nutrients within to evolve. The fruit then detaches, becoming nourishment for other creatures.

flavorText.diamond-pearl: It blooms during times of strong sunlight. It tries to make up for everything it endured as a bud.
flavorText.platinum: If it senses strong sunlight, it opens its folded petals to absorb the sun’s rays with its whole body.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: During times of strong sunlight, its bud blooms, its petals open fully, and it becomes very active.
flavorText.black-white: If it senses strong sunlight, it opens its folded petals to absorb the sun’s rays with its whole body.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: If it senses strong sunlight, it opens its folded petals to absorb the sun’s rays with its whole body.
flavorText.x-y: During times of strong sunlight, its bud blooms, its petals open fully, and it becomes very active.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: During times of strong sunlight, its bud blooms, its petals open fully, and it becomes very active.
flavorText.sword-shield: As a bud, it barely moves. It sits still, placidly waiting for sunlight to appear.
flavorText.legends-arceus: Motionless, save for the occasional quiver. A rich array of Pokémon can be found gathered around it, drawn by the scent exuded from Cherrim's folded petals.

flavorText.diamond-pearl: Its colors and shapes differ from region to region. In the Sinnoh region, two types are confirmed.
flavorText.platinum: Beware of pushing strongly on its squishy body, as it makes a mysterious purple fluid ooze out.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: Its shape and coloration vary, depending on its habitat.
flavorText.black-white: Beware of pushing strongly on its squishy body, as it makes a mysterious purple fluid ooze out.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: Beware of pushing strongly on its squishy body, as it makes a mysterious purple fluid ooze out.
flavorText.x-y: Beware of pushing strongly on its squishy body, as it makes a mysterious purple fluid ooze out.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Beware of pushing strongly on its squishy body, as it makes a mysterious purple fluid ooze out.
flavorText.sun-moon: For the most part, it makes its home along the seashore. Its color and form differ according to its habitat and the quality of its food.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: While they normally live in the sea, they can function on land, too, until their skin dries out.
flavorText.sword-shield: This Pokémon’s habitat shapes its physique. According to some theories, life in warm ocean waters causes this variation to develop.
flavorText.legends-arceus: Found in abundance on seashores bordering warm waters. Shellos are unexpectedly friendly and will crawl toward any person they see. Take care not to get coated in mucus!

flavorText.diamond-pearl: It has a pliable body without any bones. If any part of its body is torn off, it grows right back.
flavorText.platinum: Long ago, its entire back was shielded with a sturdy shell. There are traces of it left in its cells.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: When its natural enemy attacks, it oozes purple fluid and escapes.
flavorText.black-white: Long ago, its entire back was shielded with a sturdy shell. There are traces of it left in its cells.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: Long ago, its entire back was shielded with a sturdy shell. There are traces of it left in its cells.
flavorText.x-y: When its natural enemy attacks, it oozes purple fluid and escapes.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: When its natural enemy attacks, it oozes purple fluid and escapes.
flavorText.sun-moon: It has strong regenerative capabilities. Even if parts of it are bitten off by fish Pokémon, it will return to normal within a few hours.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: Long ago, it had a shell on its back. There’s now a vestigial plate on its back that’s hard but thin.
flavorText.sword-shield: Its search for food sometimes leads it onto land, where it leaves behind a sticky trail of slime as it passes through.
flavorText.legends-arceus: Eats beach sand for nourishment. Should one Gastrodon encounter another of a different color, a fierce battle will inevitably ensue.

flavorText.diamond-pearl: To eat, it deftly shucks nuts with its two tails. It rarely uses its arms now.
flavorText.platinum: Split into two, the tails are so adept at handling and doing things, AMBIPOM rarely uses its hands.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: They live on large trees. They are said to communicate by connecting their tails to those of others.
flavorText.black-white: Split into two, the tails are so adept at handling and doing things, Ambipom rarely uses its hands.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: Split into two, the tails are so adept at handling and doing things, Ambipom rarely uses its hands.
flavorText.x-y: They work in large colonies and make rings by linking their tails, apparently in friendship.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: They work in large colonies and make rings by linking their tails, apparently in friendship.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: In their search for comfortable trees, they get into territorial disputes with groups of Passimian. They win about half the time.
flavorText.legends-arceus: To affirm their kinship, members of this species will form a ring by linking their newly doubled tails together. On rare occasions, humans have been accepted into such rings.

flavorText.diamond-pearl: A Pokémon formed by the spirits of people and Pokémon. It loves damp, humid seasons.
flavorText.platinum: Because of the way it floats aimlessly, an old folktale calls it a “Signpost for Wandering Spirits.”
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: It is whispered that any child who mistakes DRIFLOON for a balloon and holds on to it could wind up missing.
flavorText.black-white: Because of the way it floats aimlessly, an old folktale calls it a “Signpost for Wandering Spirits.”
flavorText.black-2-white-2: These Pokémon are called the “Signpost for Wandering Spirits.” Children holding them sometimes vanish.
flavorText.x-y: A Pokémon formed by the spirits of people and Pokémon. It loves damp, humid seasons.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: A Pokémon formed by the spirits of people and Pokémon. It loves damp, humid seasons.
flavorText.sun-moon: Stories go that it grabs the hands of small children and drags them away to the afterlife. It dislikes heavy children.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: Its round body is stuffed with souls and expands each time it leads someone away.
flavorText.sword-shield: Perhaps seeking company, it approaches children. However, it often quickly runs away again when the children play too roughly with it.
flavorText.legends-arceus: Said to lure away young children and carry them off to the afterlife. Some whisper that Drifloon are formed of reincarnated human souls, but these rumors are as yet unconfirmed.

flavorText.diamond-pearl: It’s drowzy in daytime, but flies off in the evening in big groups. No one knows where they go.
flavorText.platinum: At dusk, swarms of them are carried aloft on winds. When noticed, they suddenly vanish.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: It can generate and release gas within its body. That’s how it can control the altitude of its drift.
flavorText.black-white: At dusk, swarms of them are carried aloft on winds. When noticed, they suddenly vanish.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: They carry people and Pokémon, but the wind can catch them, so there can’t be a fixed destination.
flavorText.x-y: It carries people and Pokémon when it flies. But since it only drifts, it can end up anywhere.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: It carries people and Pokémon when it flies. But since it only drifts, it can end up anywhere.
flavorText.sun-moon: There was once an incident in which a man took a trip riding a Drifblim, only to go missing.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: There’s a rumor that if you catch a Drifblim floating on the wind at dusk, you’ll be carried away to the afterlife.
flavorText.sword-shield: Some say this Pokémon is a collection of souls burdened with regrets, silently drifting through the dusk.
flavorText.legends-arceus: It drifts along at dusk, perfectly silent. Its transient, melancholy aspect touches some people deeply—every so often, one will come upon a song or poem devoted to Drifblim.

flavorText.diamond-pearl: It slams foes by sharply uncoiling its rolled ears. It stings enough to make a grown-up cry in pain.
flavorText.platinum: Its ears are always rolled up. They can be forcefully extended to shatter even a large boulder.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: You can tell how it feels by the way it rolls its ears. When it’s scared, both ears are rolled up.
flavorText.black-white: Its ears are always rolled up. They can be forcefully extended to shatter even a large boulder.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: By extending its rolled-up ears and striking the ground, it can bound so high it surprises itself.
flavorText.x-y: Its ears are always rolled up. They can be forcefully extended to shatter even a large boulder.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Its ears are always rolled up. They can be forcefully extended to shatter even a large boulder.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: Its arms and legs are weak, but when it rolls its ears up tight and then unleashes them with its full force, it can smash boulders to dust.
flavorText.sword-shield: If both of Buneary’s ears are rolled up, something is wrong with its body or mind. It’s a sure sign the Pokémon is in need of care.
flavorText.legends-arceus: My hypothesis as to why Buneary rolls up its ears is that its hearing is far too keen. I surmise that the Pokémon protects its hearing by limiting the sound that may enter its ears.

flavorText.diamond-pearl: An extremely cautious Pokémon. It cloaks its body with its fluffy ear fur when it senses danger.
flavorText.platinum: The ears appear to be delicate. If they are touched roughly, it kicks with its graceful legs.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: It sheds its fur twice a year. Its winter fur is soft and fluffy.
flavorText.black-white: The ears appear to be delicate. If they are touched roughly, it kicks with its graceful legs.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: Extremely cautious, it quickly bounds off when it senses danger.
flavorText.x-y: Extremely cautious, it quickly bounds off when it senses danger.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Extremely cautious, it quickly bounds off when it senses danger.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: Lopunny regrows its coat twice a year. Mufflers and hats made from its fur are really warm.
flavorText.sword-shield: Lopunny is constantly monitoring its surroundings. If danger approaches, this Pokémon responds with superdestructive kicks.
flavorText.legends-arceus: Its fur is warm and yet remarkably light. This Pokémon kicks as though it were a master of karate, driving back its opponents with ease.

flavorText.diamond-pearl: Its cries sound like incantations. Those hearing it are tormented by headaches and hallucinations.
flavorText.platinum: Its cry sounds like an incantation. It is said the cry may rarely be imbued with happiness-giving power.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: Its cries sound like incantations to torment the foe. It appears where you least expect it.
flavorText.black-white: Its cry sounds like an incantation. It is said the cry may rarely be imbued with happiness-giving power.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: Its cry sounds like an incantation. It is said the cry may rarely be imbued with happiness-giving power.
flavorText.x-y: It chants incantations. While they usually torment targets, some chants bring happiness.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: It chants incantations. While they usually torment targets, some chants bring happiness.
flavorText.sun-moon: It appears as if from nowhere—muttering incantations, placing curses, and giving people terrifying visions.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: Feared for its wrath and the curses it spreads, this Pokémon will also, on a whim, cast spells that help people.
flavorText.legends-arceus: The incantations Mismagius chants can ward against misfortune, so a custom exists of inviting it into one's home. Incur the Pokémon's displeasure, however, and disaster will surely ensue.

flavorText.diamond-pearl: Becoming active at night, it is known to swarm with numerous MURKROW in tow.
flavorText.platinum: If one utters a deep cry, many MURKROW gather quickly. For this, it is called “Summoner of Night.”
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: It is merciless by nature. It is said that it never forgives the mistakes of its MURKROW followers.
flavorText.black-white: If one utters a deep cry, many Murkrow gather quickly. For this, it is called “Summoner of Night.”
flavorText.black-2-white-2: If one utters a deep cry, many Murkrow gather quickly. For this, it is called “Summoner of Night.”
flavorText.x-y: If one utters a deep cry, many Murkrow gather quickly. For this, it is called “Summoner of Night.”
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: If one utters a deep cry, many Murkrow gather quickly. For this, it is called “Summoner of Night.”
flavorText.sun-moon: A single cry from this nocturnal Pokémon, and more than a hundred of its Murkrow cronies will assemble.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: It will absolutely not forgive failure from or betrayal by its goons. It has no choice in this if it wants to maintain the order of the flock.
flavorText.legends-arceus: One cry from this Pokémon, and a murder of Murkrow come flying. At such times, one would think the curtain of night had fallen, plunging the world into jet-black darkness.

flavorText.diamond-pearl: It claws if displeased and purrs when affectionate. Its fickleness is very popular among some.
flavorText.platinum: It hides its spiteful tendency of hooking its claws into the nose of its Trainer if it isn’t fed.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: When it’s happy, GLAMEOW demonstrates beautiful movements of its tail, like a dancing ribbon.
flavorText.black-white: It hides its spiteful tendency of hooking its claws into the nose of its Trainer if it isn’t fed.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: It hides its spiteful tendency of hooking its claws into the nose of its Trainer if it isn’t fed.
flavorText.x-y: It claws if displeased and purrs when affectionate. Its fickleness is very popular among some.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: It claws if displeased and purrs when affectionate. Its fickleness is very popular among some.
flavorText.legends-arceus: Bewitches humans with its helical tail and piercing gaze. Its hidden claws are quite sharp as well, making this Pokémon an exceedingly tricky opponent if antagonized.

flavorText.diamond-pearl: It is a brazen brute that barges its way into another Pokémon’s nest and claims it as its own.
flavorText.platinum: It binds its body with its tails to make itself look bigger. If it locks eyes, it will glare ceaselessly.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: It would claim another Pokémon’s nest as its own if it finds a nest sufficiently comfortable.
flavorText.black-white: It binds its body with its tails to make itself look bigger. If it locks eyes, it will glare ceaselessly.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: It binds its body with its tails to make itself look bigger. If it locks eyes, it will glare ceaselessly.
flavorText.x-y: It would claim another Pokémon’s nest as its own if it finds a nest sufficiently comfortable.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: It would claim another Pokémon’s nest as its own if it finds a nest sufficiently comfortable.
flavorText.legends-arceus: Though impudent and difficult to tame, Purugly enjoys great popularity due to its fur, the beauty of which surpasses even velveteen.

flavorText.diamond-pearl: It emits cries by agitating an orb at the back of its throat. It moves with flouncing hops.
flavorText.platinum: There is an orb inside its mouth. When it hops, the orb bounces all over and makes a ringing sound.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: It emits high-frequency cries that people can’t hear. Once it starts, it can cry for an awfully long time.
flavorText.black-white: There is an orb inside its mouth. When it hops, the orb bounces all over and makes a ringing sound.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: There is an orb inside its mouth. When it hops, the orb bounces all over and makes a ringing sound.
flavorText.x-y: Each time it hops, it makes a ringing sound. It deafens foes by emitting high-frequency cries.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Each time it hops, it makes a ringing sound. It deafens foes by emitting high-frequency cries.
flavorText.legends-arceus: This Pokémon gave me an excruciating headache when it seemingly cried out without making a sound. Perhaps there are some sounds that the human ear is simply incapable of hearing.

flavorText.diamond-pearl: It protects itself by spraying a noxious fluid from its rear. The stench lingers for 24 hours.
flavorText.platinum: It sprays a foul fluid from its rear. Its stench spreads over a mile radius, driving Pokémon away.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: The foul fluid from its rear is so revolting that it can make people feel queasy up to a mile and a quarter away.
flavorText.black-white: It sprays a foul fluid from its rear. Its stench spreads over a mile radius, driving Pokémon away.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: It sprays a foul fluid from its rear. Its stench spreads over a mile radius, driving Pokémon away.
flavorText.x-y: It sprays a foul fluid from its rear. Its stench spreads over a mile radius, driving Pokémon away.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: It sprays a foul fluid from its rear. Its stench spreads over a mile radius, driving Pokémon away.
flavorText.sword-shield: From its rear, it sprays a foul-smelling liquid at opponents. It aims for their faces, and it can hit them from over 16 feet away.
flavorText.legends-arceus: The poison that gushes from its aft end is accompanied by an utterly evil-smelling odor with such potency that one whiff can induce memory loss.

flavorText.diamond-pearl: It sprays a vile-smelling fluid from the tip of its tail to attack. Its range is over 160 feet.
flavorText.platinum: It attacks by spraying a horribly smelly fluid from the tip of its tail. Attacks from above confound it.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: It attacks by spraying a repugnant fluid from its tail, but the stench dulls after a few squirts.
flavorText.black-white: It attacks by spraying a horribly smelly fluid from the tip of its tail. Attacks from above confound it.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: It attacks by spraying a horribly smelly fluid from the tip of its tail. Attacks from above confound it.
flavorText.x-y: It sprays a vile-smelling fluid from the tip of its tail to attack. Its range is over 160 feet.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: It sprays a vile-smelling fluid from the tip of its tail to attack. Its range is over 160 feet.
flavorText.sword-shield: In its belly, it reserves stinky fluid that it shoots from its tail during battle. As this Pokémon’s diet varies, so does the stench of its fluid.
flavorText.legends-arceus: Sprays a poisonous fluid to take down prey. Sometimes, unable to stomach the stench of its own fluid, it leaves the bested prey uneaten.

flavorText.diamond-pearl: Implements shaped like it were discovered in ancient tombs. It is unknown if they are related.
flavorText.platinum: There are researchers who believe this Pokémon reflected like a mirror in the distant past.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: Ancient people believed that the pattern on BRONZOR’s back contained a mysterious power.
flavorText.black-white: There are researchers who believe this Pokémon reflected like a mirror in the distant past.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: They are found in ancient tombs. The patterns on their backs are said to be imbued with mysterious power.
flavorText.x-y: Ancient people believed that the pattern on Bronzor’s back contained a mysterious power.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Ancient people believed that the pattern on Bronzor’s back contained a mysterious power.
flavorText.sword-shield: It appears in ancient ruins. The pattern on its body doesn’t come from any culture in the Galar region, so it remains shrouded in mystery.
flavorText.legends-arceus: Floats using a mysterious energy. The pattern engraved upon its back is held as sacred and can sometimes be found in imagery from ancient cemeteries and other such timeworn places.

flavorText.diamond-pearl: One caused a news sensation when it was dug up at a construction site after a 2,000-year sleep.
flavorText.platinum: It brought rains by opening portals to another world. It was revered as a bringer of plentiful harvests.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: Ancient people believed that petitioning BRONZONG for rain was the way to make crops grow.
flavorText.black-white: It brought rains by opening portals to another world. It was revered as a bringer of plentiful harvests.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: In ages past, this Pokémon was revered as a bringer of rain. It was found buried in the ground.
flavorText.x-y: In ages past, this Pokémon was revered as a bringer of rain. It was found buried in the ground.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: In ages past, this Pokémon was revered as a bringer of rain. It was found buried in the ground.
flavorText.sword-shield: Some believe it to be a deity that summons rain clouds. When angered, it lets out a warning cry that rings out like the tolling of a bell.
flavorText.legends-arceus: Some believe that its bell-like cry opens holes to another world. It has been revered as a deity since ancient times.

flavorText.diamond-pearl: It looks as if it is always crying. It is actually adjusting its body’s fluid levels by eliminating excess.
flavorText.platinum: It prefers an arid atmosphere. It leaks water that looks like tears when adjusting its moisture level.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: In order to adjust the level of fluids in its body, it exudes water from its eyes. This makes it appear to be crying.
flavorText.black-white: It prefers an arid atmosphere. It leaks water that looks like tears when adjusting its moisture level.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: It prefers an arid atmosphere. It leaks water that looks like tears when adjusting its moisture level.
flavorText.x-y: It prefers arid environments. It leaks water from its eyes to adjust its body’s fluid levels.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: It prefers arid environments. It leaks water from its eyes to adjust its body’s fluid levels.
flavorText.sun-moon: It does not deal well with water, so it lives in dry locales. Since its surroundings tend to lack greenery, it stands out noticeably.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: It discharges moisture from its eyes, making it look like it’s crying—apparently an effective way of getting enemies to let down their guard.
flavorText.sword-shield: It expels both sweat and tears from its eyes. The sweat is a little salty, while the tears have a slight bitterness.
flavorText.legends-arceus: Its tears elicit sympathy from those who see them, but do not be deceived! This expulsion of body water is merely a physiological mechanism for keeping itself in good health.

flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: In an attempt to confuse its enemy, it mimics the enemy’s movements. Then it wastes no time in making itself scarce!
flavorText.diamond-pearl: It habitually mimics foes. Once mimicked, the foe cannot take its eyes off this Pokémon.
flavorText.platinum: It mimics the expressions and motions of those it sees to understand the feelings of others.
flavorText.black-white: It mimics the expressions and motions of those it sees to understand the feelings of others.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: It mimics the expressions and motions of those it sees to understand the feelings of others.
flavorText.x-y: In an attempt to confuse its enemy, it mimics the enemy’s movements. Then it wastes no time in making itself scarce!
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: In an attempt to confuse its enemy, it mimics the enemy’s movements. Then it wastes no time in making itself scarce!
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: It does its absolute best to mimic the movements and expressions of its opponents, but it’s still not very good at it.
flavorText.sword-shield: It mimics everyone it sees, but it puts extra effort into copying the graceful dance steps of Mr. Rime as practice.
flavorText.legends-arceus: Known to turn up in bustling marketplaces now and again. It mimics people much as a child would, then watches how they react, eyes sparkling.

flavorText.diamond-pearl: It loves round white things. It carries an egg-shaped rock in imitation of CHANSEY.
flavorText.platinum: It likes to carry around a small rock. It may wander around others’ feet and cause them to stumble.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: It carefully carries a round, white rock that it thinks is an egg. It’s bothered by how curly its hair looks.
flavorText.black-white: It likes to carry around a small rock. It may wander around others’ feet and cause them to stumble.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: It likes to carry around a small rock. It may wander around others’ feet and cause them to stumble.
flavorText.x-y: It carries a round, egg-shaped rock in its belly pouch and gives the rock to its friends.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: It carries a round, egg-shaped rock in its belly pouch and gives the rock to its friends.
flavorText.sun-moon: It carries a round white rock in its belly pouch. If it gets along well with someone, it will sometimes give that person the rock.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: Usually it’s a well-behaved Pokémon, but if you take its round rock away, it will cry and fuss and throw a big old tantrum.
flavorText.sword-shield: Mimicking Chansey, Happiny will place an egg- shaped stone in its belly pouch. Happiny will treasure this stone.
flavorText.legends-arceus: In imitation of Chansey, it keeps a round stone tucked into its belly pouch and cherishes it dearly. It gets along well with children and will sometimes play house with them for fun.

flavorText.diamond-pearl: It can learn and speak human words. If they gather, they all learn the same saying.
flavorText.platinum: Its tongue is just like a human’s. As a result, it can cleverly mimic human speech.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: It mimics the cries of other Pokémon to trick them into thinking it’s one of them. This way they won’t attack it.
flavorText.black-white: Its tongue is just like a human’s. As a result, it can cleverly mimic human speech.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: Its tongue is just like a human’s. As a result, it can cleverly mimic human speech.
flavorText.x-y: It mimics the cries of other Pokémon to trick them into thinking it’s one of them. This way they won’t attack it.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: It mimics the cries of other Pokémon to trick them into thinking it’s one of them. This way they won’t attack it.
flavorText.legends-arceus: A versatile performer skilled in the imitation of human speech. It is said that older, more experienced Chatot can even understand the meaning of the words they mimic.

flavorText.diamond-pearl: A Pokémon that was formed by 108 spirits. It is bound to a fissure in an odd keystone.
flavorText.platinum: Its constant mischief and misdeeds resulted in it being bound to an Odd Keystone by a mysterious spell.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: It was formed by uniting 108 spirits. It has been bound to the Odd Keystone to keep it from doing any mischief.
flavorText.black-white: Its constant mischief and misdeeds resulted in it being bound to an Odd Keystone by a mysterious spell.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: Its constant mischief and misdeeds resulted in it being bound to an Odd Keystone by a mysterious spell.
flavorText.x-y: A Pokémon that was formed by 108 spirits. It is bound to a fissure in an odd keystone.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: A Pokémon that was formed by 108 spirits. It is bound to a fissure in an odd keystone.
flavorText.sword-shield: Exactly 108 spirits gathered to become this Pokémon. Apparently there are some ill-natured spirits in the mix.
flavorText.legends-arceus: It lays curses by thinking wicked thoughts. Writings tell that this Pokémon was born out of the assembly of five score and eight malevolent spirits.

flavorText.diamond-pearl: It nests in small, horizontal holes in cave walls. It pounces to catch prey that stray too close.
flavorText.platinum: It attacks using its huge mouth. While its attacks are powerful, it hurts itself out of clumsiness, too.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: It nests in horizontal holes warmed by geothermal heat. Foes who get too close can expect to be pounced on and bitten.
flavorText.black-white: It attacks using its huge mouth. While its attacks are powerful, it hurts itself out of clumsiness, too.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: It attacks using its huge mouth. While its attacks are powerful, it hurts itself out of clumsiness, too.
flavorText.x-y: It nests in horizontal holes warmed by geothermal heat. Foes who get too close can expect to be pounced on and bitten.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: It nests in horizontal holes warmed by geothermal heat. Foes who get too close can expect to be pounced on and bitten.
flavorText.sun-moon: It lives in caves warmed by geothermal heat. Even so, when the weather gets cold, it will huddle close with others of its kind.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: It reacts to anything that moves—flies right at it and bites it. Sometimes it injures itself, but it doesn’t care too much.
flavorText.sword-shield: Gible prefers to stay in narrow holes in the sides of caves heated by geothermal energy. This way, Gible can stay warm even during a blizzard.
flavorText.legends-arceus: It nests in caves untouched by sunlight. Its sharp teeth may fall out when worn away or after an impact, but they regrow within a few days.

flavorText.diamond-pearl: There is a long-held belief that medicine made from its scales will heal even incurable illnesses.
flavorText.platinum: It loves sparkly things. It seeks treasures in caves and hoards the loot in its nest.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: As it digs to expand its nest, it habitually digs up gems that it then hoards in its nest.
flavorText.black-white: It loves sparkly things. It seeks treasures in caves and hoards the loot in its nest.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: It loves sparkly things. It seeks treasures in caves and hoards the loot in its nest.
flavorText.x-y: It loves sparkly things. It seeks treasures in caves and hoards the loot in its nest.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: It loves sparkly things. It seeks treasures in caves and hoards the loot in its nest.
flavorText.sun-moon: In rare cases, it molts and sheds its scales. Medicine containing its scales as an ingredient will make a weary body feel invigorated.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: It loves shiny things. When it finds a Sableye trying to catch a Carbink, Gabite becomes furiously angry and attacks the Sableye.
flavorText.sword-shield: This Pokémon emits ultrasonic waves from a protrusion on either side of its head to probe pitch-dark caves.
flavorText.legends-arceus: Though Gabite are usually of a violent disposition, when I gave one a glass bead it had been eyeing covetously, it suddenly became quite docile.

flavorText.diamond-pearl: When it folds up its body and extends its wings, it looks like a jet plane. It flies at sonic speed.
flavorText.platinum: It is said that when one runs at high speed, its wings create blades of wind that can fell nearby trees.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: Its body is covered in fine scales that reduce drag, enabling it to fly at high speeds.
flavorText.black-white: It is said that when one runs at high speed, its wings create blades of wind that can fell nearby trees.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: It is said that when one runs at high speed, its wings create blades of wind that can fell nearby trees.
flavorText.x-y: When it folds up its body and extends its wings, it looks like a jet plane. It flies at sonic speed.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: When it folds up its body and extends its wings, it looks like a jet plane. It flies at sonic speed.
flavorText.sun-moon: It can fly at speeds rivaling jet planes. It dives into flocks of bird Pokémon and gulps the entire flock down whole.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: It flies at the speed of sound while searching for prey, and it has midair battles with Salamence as the two compete for food.
flavorText.sword-shield: Garchomp makes its home in volcanic mountains. It flies through the sky as fast as a jet airplane, hunting down as much prey as it can.
flavorText.legends-arceus: Soars across the heavens at blinding speed—a magnificent sight! It has a feral disposition. Utmost caution is required if one meets a Garchomp out in the wilds.

flavorText.diamond-pearl: It wolfs down its weight in food once a day, swallowing food whole with almost no chewing.
flavorText.platinum: In its desperation to gulp down food, it forgets about the food it has hidden under its fur.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: It conceals food under the long fur on its body. It carts around this food stash and swallows it without chewing.
flavorText.black-white: In its desperation to gulp down food, it forgets about the food it has hidden under its fur.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: In its desperation to gulp down food, it forgets about the food it has hidden under its fur.
flavorText.x-y: It hides food under its long body hair. However, it forgets it has hidden the food.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: It hides food under its long body hair. However, it forgets it has hidden the food.
flavorText.sun-moon: It needs to consume its own weight in food every day. As far as flavor is concerned, it’s indifferent.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: It hides food under its long fur, but it sometimes forgets about it and causes a stinky disturbance.
flavorText.sword-shield: Stuffing itself with vast amounts of food is its only concern. Whether the food is rotten or fresh, yummy or tasteless—it does not care.
flavorText.legends-arceus: Its robust stomach allows it to nonchalantly devour even rotted matter. It pays frequent visits to villages, seeking out food scraps intended for compost.

flavorText.diamond-pearl: The aura that emanates from its body intensifies to alert others if it is afraid or sad.
flavorText.platinum: It has the peculiar power of being able to see emotions such as joy and rage in the form of waves.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: They communicate with one another using their auras. They are able to run all through the night.
flavorText.black-white: It has the peculiar power of being able to see emotions such as joy and rage in the form of waves.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: It uses the shapes of auras, which change according to emotion, to communicate with others.
flavorText.x-y: It uses the shapes of auras, which change according to emotion, to communicate with others.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: It uses the shapes of auras, which change according to emotion, to communicate with others.
flavorText.sun-moon: It can discern the physical and emotional states of people, Pokémon, and other natural things from the shape of their aura waves.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: It knows how people and Pokémon feel by looking at their auras. It doesn’t approach dangerous opponents.
flavorText.sword-shield: It’s exceedingly energetic, with enough stamina to keep running all through the night. Taking it for walks can be a challenging experience.
flavorText.legends-arceus: Though infantile in appearance, it has the mysterious ability to read the minds of humans. The pure of heart are met with Riolu's approval, while those of ill nature earn only its loathing.

flavorText.diamond-pearl: It has the ability to sense the auras of all things. It understands human speech.
flavorText.platinum: A well-trained one can sense auras to identify and take in the feelings of creatures over half a mile away.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: It’s said that no foe can remain invisible to LUCARIO, since it can detect auras. Even foes it could not otherwise see.
flavorText.black-white: A well-trained one can sense auras to identify and take in the feelings of creatures over half a mile away.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: By reading the auras of all things, it can tell how others are feeling from over half a mile away.
flavorText.x-y: By catching the aura emanating from others, it can read their thoughts and movements.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: By catching the aura emanating from others, it can read their thoughts and movements.
flavorText.sun-moon: Not only does it perceive auras, but it has also gained the power to control them. It employs them in battle.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: It concentrates its mental energy and fires off mysterious waves called auras, which can crush boulders of large size to dust.
flavorText.sword-shield: It controls waves known as auras, which are powerful enough to pulverize huge rocks. It uses these waves to take down its prey.
flavorText.legends-arceus: A most gallant-looking creature. It emits energy waves and controls them with precision, using them to sense even faraway beings. I have given the name ”aura” to this power.

flavorText.diamond-pearl: It lives in arid places. Instead of perspiration, it expels grainy sand from its body.
flavorText.platinum: It shuts its nostrils tight then travels through sand as if walking. They form colonies of around ten.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: It shrouds itself in sand to ward off germs. It travels easily through the sands of the desert.
flavorText.black-white: It shuts its nostrils tight then travels through sand as if walking. They form colonies of around ten.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: It shuts its nostrils tight then travels through sand as if walking. They form colonies of around 10.
flavorText.x-y: It lives in arid places. Instead of perspiration, it expels grainy sand from its body.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: It lives in arid places. Instead of perspiration, it expels grainy sand from its body.
flavorText.sword-shield: It moves through the sands with its mouth open, swallowing sand along with its prey. It gets rid of the sand by spouting it from its nose.
flavorText.legends-arceus: Though large and languid, Hippopotas is difficult to detect due to its tendency to burrow into and lurk beneath the soil. When agitated or excited, it expels sand from its nostrils.

flavorText.diamond-pearl: It blasts internally stored sand from ports on its body to create a towering twister for attack.
flavorText.platinum: It is surprisingly quick to anger. It holds its mouth agape as a display of its strength.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: It brandishes its gaping mouth in a display of fearsome strength. It raises vast quantities of sand while attacking.
flavorText.black-white: It is surprisingly quick to anger. It holds its mouth agape as a display of its strength.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: It is surprisingly quick to anger. It holds its mouth agape as a display of its strength.
flavorText.x-y: It brandishes its gaping mouth in a display of fearsome strength. It raises vast quantities of sand while attacking.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: It brandishes its gaping mouth in a display of fearsome strength. It raises vast quantities of sand while attacking.
flavorText.sword-shield: Stones can get stuck in the ports on their bodies. Dwebble help dislodge such stones, so Hippowdon look after these Pokémon.
flavorText.legends-arceus: Short-tempered and easily moved to violence. It whips up whirlwinds of sand to crush its foes' spirits, then goes in for the attack.

flavorText.diamond-pearl: It grips prey with its tail claws and injects poison. It tenaciously hangs on until the poison takes.
flavorText.platinum: As soon as the tail claws close, its needle tips secrete poison. It can survive a year without food.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: It burrows under the sand to lie in wait for prey. Its tail claws can inject its prey with a savage poison.
flavorText.black-white: As soon as the tail claws close, its needle tips secrete poison. It can survive a year without food.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: It lives in arid regions and can go without food for a year while waiting for prey.
flavorText.x-y: It grips prey with its tail claws and injects poison. It tenaciously hangs on until the poison takes.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: It grips prey with its tail claws and injects poison. It tenaciously hangs on until the poison takes.
flavorText.sword-shield: After burrowing into the sand, it waits patiently for prey to come near. This Pokémon and Sizzlipede share common descent.
flavorText.legends-arceus: Its claws are not only razor-sharp but poisonous, making Skorupi a highly dangerous Pokémon. It seems to be weakened by cold temperatures, however.

flavorText.diamond-pearl: It has the power in its clawed arms to make scrap of a car. The tips of its claws release poison.
flavorText.platinum: Possessing a sturdy build, it takes pride in its strength, taking down foes without using toxins.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: It attacks people and Pokémon that cross the desert. This has only furthered its bad reputation.
flavorText.black-white: Possessing a sturdy build, it takes pride in its strength, taking down foes without using toxins.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: It takes pride in its strength. Even though it can tear foes apart, it finishes them off with powerful poison.
flavorText.x-y: It takes pride in its strength. Even though it can tear foes apart, it finishes them off with powerful poison.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: It takes pride in its strength. Even though it can tear foes apart, it finishes them off with powerful poison.
flavorText.sword-shield: Its poison is potent, but it rarely sees use. This Pokémon prefers to use physical force instead, going on rampages with its car-crushing strength.
flavorText.legends-arceus: Has a brutish, ferocious temperament. With immense strength and a sturdy shell off which swords will bounce, it rampages about and wreaks havoc.

flavorText.diamond-pearl: Its cheeks hold poison sacs. It tries to catch foes off guard to jab them with toxic fingers.
flavorText.platinum: It rarely fights fairly, but that is strictly to ensure survival. It is popular as a mascot.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: Fluid squeezed from its finger, albeit poisonous, is a significant ingredient in remedies for lower-back pain.
