flavorText.black-white: It rarely fights fairly, but that is strictly to ensure survival. It is popular as a mascot.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: Inflating its poison sacs, it fills the area with an odd sound and hits flinching opponents with a poison jab.
flavorText.x-y: Its cheeks hold poison sacs. It tries to catch foes off guard to jab them with toxic fingers.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Its cheeks hold poison sacs. It tries to catch foes off guard to jab them with toxic fingers.
flavorText.sword-shield: It makes frightening noises with its poison-filled cheek sacs. When opponents flinch, Croagunk hits them with a poison jab.
flavorText.legends-arceus: A poison wielder with a dastardly personality. Despite such qualities, this species is afforded a measure of popularity due to its peculiar cry and comical features.

flavorText.diamond-pearl: Its knuckle claws secrete a toxin so vile that even a scratch could prove fatal.
flavorText.platinum: It has a poison sac at its throat. When it croaks, the stored poison is churned for greater potency.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: Swaying and dodging the attacks of its foes, it weaves its flexible body in close, then lunges out with its poisonous claws.
flavorText.black-white: It has a poison sac at its throat. When it croaks, the stored poison is churned for greater potency.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: The croaking that Toxicroak produces before a battle is for churning the poison it has stored in its poison sac.
flavorText.x-y: It has a poison sac at its throat. When it croaks, the stored poison is churned for greater potency.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: It has a poison sac at its throat. When it croaks, the stored poison is churned for greater potency.
flavorText.sword-shield: It bounces toward opponents and gouges them with poisonous claws. No more than a scratch is needed to knock out its adversaries.
flavorText.legends-arceus: Its crimson claws contain a virulent toxin. This toxin can be made into a tonic by diluting it, mixing it with several types of wild grass, and boiling it down over two days.

flavorText.diamond-pearl: It attracts prey with its sweet- smelling saliva, then chomps down. It takes a whole day to eat prey.
flavorText.platinum: It binds itself to trees in marshes. It attracts prey with its sweet- smelling drool and gulps them down.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: It walks around on its tentacles in search of a tree branch where it can dangle down and ambush prey.
flavorText.black-white: It binds itself to trees in marshes. It attracts prey with its sweet- smelling drool and gulps them down.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: Using its tentacles to lash itself to trees, it lies in wait for prey, luring it close with sweet-smelling drool.
flavorText.x-y: It attracts prey with its sweet-smelling saliva, then chomps down. It takes a whole day to eat prey.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: It attracts prey with its sweet-smelling saliva, then chomps down. It takes a whole day to eat prey.
flavorText.legends-arceus: Though this is a plant Pokémon, it has a gluttonous and unruly temperament. Carnivine attacks its prey with its cavernous maw wide open.

flavorText.diamond-pearl: After long exposure to sunlight, the patterns on its tail fins shine vividly when darkness arrives.
flavorText.platinum: The line running down its side can store sunlight. It shines vividly at night.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: Swimming and fluttering its two tail fins, it looks like a BEAUTIFLY. At night, the patterns on its tail fins softly shine.
flavorText.black-white: The line running down its side can store sunlight. It shines vividly at night.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: The line running down its side can store sunlight. It shines vividly at night.
flavorText.x-y: The line running down its side can store sunlight. It shines vividly at night.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: The line running down its side can store sunlight. It shines vividly at night.
flavorText.sun-moon: It absorbs sunlight with the pink areas of its skin, which then shine. This appears to be a form of camouflage.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: When night falls, their pink patterns begin to shine. They’re popular with divers, so there are resorts that feed them to keep them close.
flavorText.legends-arceus: What a gorgeous sight this Pokémon is as it swims with its long, pink-painted caudal fins fluttering behind it. Finneon's beautiful appearance has led to its nickname: ”finery fish.”

flavorText.diamond-pearl: It lives on the deep-sea floor. It attracts prey by flashing the patterns on its four tail fins.
flavorText.platinum: It crawls along the seafloor using its long front fins like legs. It competes for food with LANTURN.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: LUMINEON swimming in the darkness of the deep sea look like stars shining in the night sky.
flavorText.black-white: It crawls along the seafloor using its long front fins like legs. It competes for food with Lanturn.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: It crawls along the seafloor using its long front fins like legs. It competes for food with Lanturn.
flavorText.x-y: It lives on the deep-sea floor. It attracts prey by flashing the patterns on its four tail fins.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: It lives on the deep-sea floor. It attracts prey by flashing the patterns on its four tail fins.
flavorText.sun-moon: With its shining light, it lures its prey close. However, the light also happens to attract ferocious fish Pokémon—its natural predators.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: Deep down at the bottom of the ocean, prey is scarce. Lumineon get into fierce disputes with Lanturn over food.
flavorText.legends-arceus: Uses its gleaming fins to hunt its prey. The view of Lumineon schooling near the surface of the sea at night is breathtaking— it's as though there were shining stars right there.

flavorText.diamond-pearl: A friendly Pokémon that captures the subtle flows of seawater using its two antennae.
flavorText.platinum: People organize tours to see this Pokémon frolic and skim the tops of waves with REMORAID.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: When it swims close to the surface of the ocean, people aboard ships are able to observe the pattern on its back.
flavorText.black-white: People organize tours to see this Pokémon frolic and skim the tops of waves with Remoraid.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: The pattern on its back varies by region. It often swims in a school of Remoraid.
flavorText.x-y: The pattern on its back varies by region. It often swims in a school of Remoraid.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: The pattern on its back varies by region. It often swims in a school of Remoraid.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: It’s highly friendly and easily tamed. Tours that take people swimming with Mantyke are a super-popular beach activity.
flavorText.sword-shield: Mantyke living in Galar seem to be somewhat sluggish. The colder waters of the seas in this region may be the cause.
flavorText.legends-arceus: Though ball-like in shape, this Pokémon is a proficient swimmer. I have discovered that if a Mantyke spends much time with schools of Remoraid, it will eventually achieve evolution.

flavorText.diamond-pearl: It lives on snowy mountains. Having had little contact with humans, it is boldly inquisitive.
flavorText.platinum: Seemingly curious about people, they gather around footsteps they find on snowy mountains.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: During cold seasons, it migrates to the mountain’s lower reaches. It returns to the snow-covered summit in the spring.
flavorText.black-white: Seemingly curious about people, they gather around footsteps they find on snowy mountains.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: Seemingly curious about people, they gather around footsteps they find on snowy mountains.
flavorText.x-y: During cold seasons, it migrates to the mountain’s lower reaches. It returns to the snow-covered summit in the spring.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: During cold seasons, it migrates to the mountain’s lower reaches. It returns to the snow-covered summit in the spring.
flavorText.sword-shield: It lives on snowy mountains. It sinks its legs into the snow to absorb water and keep its own temperature down.
flavorText.legends-arceus: One is likely to encounter this Pokémon while out in the snow. There are stories of Snover appearing in human settlements but doing no harm—rather, they bond with the children.

flavorText.diamond-pearl: It whips up blizzards in mountains that are always buried in snow. It is the abominable snowman.
flavorText.platinum: They appear when the snow flowers bloom. When the petals fall, they retreat to places unknown again.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: It lives a quiet life on mountains that are perpetually covered in snow. It hides itself by whipping up blizzards.
flavorText.black-white: They appear when the snow flowers bloom. When the petals fall, they retreat to places unknown again.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: They appear when the snow flowers bloom. When the petals fall, they retreat to places unknown again.
flavorText.x-y: It blankets wide areas in snow by whipping up blizzards. It is also known as “The Ice Monster.”
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: It blankets wide areas in snow by whipping up blizzards. It is also known as “The Ice Monster.”
flavorText.sword-shield: If it sees any packs of Darumaka going after Snover, it chases them off, swinging its sizable arms like hammers.
flavorText.legends-arceus: A powerful Pokémon that can split huge boulders with ease. Dislikes associating with others and chooses to live quietly deep within the mountains, playing with the snow.

flavorText.black-2-white-2: They communicate by clawing signs in boulders and work together to surround enemies.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: They live in cold regions, forming groups of four or five that hunt prey with impressive coordination.
flavorText.platinum: Evolution made it even more devious. It communicates by clawing signs in boulders.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: It lives in snowy regions. It carves patterns in trees with its claws as a signal to others.
flavorText.black-white: Evolution made it even more devious. It communicates by clawing signs in boulders.
flavorText.x-y: It lives in snowy regions. It carves patterns in trees with its claws as a signal to others.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: It lives in snowy regions. It carves patterns in trees with its claws as a signal to others.
flavorText.sun-moon: They travel in groups of four or five, leaving signs for one another on trees and rocks. They bring down their prey with coordinated attacks.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: One Weavile will trip a Sandshrew and flip it over, and then another Weavile will deal the finishing blow with its sharp claws.
flavorText.sword-shield: They attack their quarry in packs. Prey as large as Mamoswine easily fall to the teamwork of a group of Weavile.
flavorText.legends-arceus: This species corners prey as a pack, under the guidance of a leader. Weavile displays increased cunning, leading me to speculate that its evolution caused further brain development.

flavorText.diamond-pearl: It evolved from exposure to a special magnetic field. Three units generate magnetism.
flavorText.platinum: A group tried to use scientific means to make MAGNEZONE evolve, but their efforts ended in failure.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: Exposure to a special magnetic field changed MAGNETON’s molecular structure, turning it into MAGNEZONE.
flavorText.black-white: A group tried to use scientific means to make Magnezone evolve, but their efforts ended in failure.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: Sometimes the magnetism emitted by Magnezone is too strong, making them attract each other so they cannot move.
flavorText.x-y: Sometimes the magnetism emitted by Magnezone is too strong, making them attract each other so they cannot move.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Sometimes the magnetism emitted by Magnezone is too strong, making them attract each other so they cannot move.
flavorText.sun-moon: Three units generate magnetism. There have been many mistaken reports of UFO sightings when Magnezone flies through the night sky.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: It uses radar to monitor its territory. Intruders are quickly disposed of with a hyper beam.
flavorText.sword-shield: Some say that Magnezone receives signals from space via the antenna on its head and that it’s being controlled by some mysterious being.
flavorText.legends-arceus: I theorize that a special magnetic field influenced this Pokémon, changing its molecular structure and causing it to evolve. It emits strange radio waves toward space from its antenna.

flavorText.diamond-pearl: It wraps things with its extensible tongue. Getting too close to it will leave you soaked with drool.
flavorText.platinum: The long tongue is always soggy with slobber. The saliva contains a solvent that causes numbness.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: Its saliva can decompose anything. It wraps its long tongue around things to coat them with its sticky saliva.
flavorText.black-white: The long tongue is always soggy with slobber. The saliva contains a solvent that causes numbness.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: Their saliva contains lots of components that can dissolve anything. The numbness caused by their lick does not dissipate.
flavorText.x-y: It wraps things with its extensible tongue. Getting too close to it will leave you soaked with drool.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: It wraps things with its extensible tongue. Getting too close to it will leave you soaked with drool.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: A contest is under way to determine which one can stick its tongue out the farthest. The current record is...more than 82 feet.
flavorText.sword-shield: Lickilicky’s strange tongue can stretch to many times the length of its body. No one has figured out how Lickilicky’s tongue can stretch so far.
flavorText.legends-arceus: Its tongue can extend and contract freely, and it is capable of reaching lengths over 10 times Lickilicky's height. Beware of the saliva, as it contains corrosive elements.

flavorText.diamond-pearl: It puts rocks in holes in its palms and uses its muscles to shoot them. GEODUDE are shot at rare times.
flavorText.platinum: It can launch a rock held in its hand like a missile by tightening then expanding muscles instantly.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: From holes in its palms, it fires out GEODUDE. Its carapace can withstand volcanic eruptions.
flavorText.black-white: It can launch a rock held in its hand like a missile by tightening then expanding muscles instantly.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: It can launch a rock held in its hand like a missile by tightening then expanding muscles instantly.
flavorText.x-y: From holes in its palms, it fires out Geodude. Its carapace can withstand volcanic eruptions.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: From holes in its palms, it fires out Geodude. Its carapace can withstand volcanic eruptions.
flavorText.sword-shield: It can load up to three projectiles per arm into the holes in its hands. What launches out of those holes could be either rocks or Roggenrola.
flavorText.legends-arceus: This Pokémon evolved through use of a curious item. Its rocklike hide is composed of a mysterious substance and can withstand a blow from a masterwork sword with nary a scratch.

flavorText.diamond-pearl: It ensnares prey by extending arms made of vines. Losing arms to predators does not trouble it.
flavorText.platinum: Its arms are made of plants that bind themselves to things. They grow back right away if cut.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: When it remains still, it appears to be a large shrub. Unsuspecting prey that wander near get ensnared by its vines.
flavorText.black-white: Its arms are made of plants that bind themselves to things. They grow back right away if cut.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: Even if one of its arms is eaten, it’s fine. The Pokémon regenerates quickly and will go right back to normal.
flavorText.x-y: It ensnares prey by extending arms made of vines. Losing arms to predators does not trouble it.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: It ensnares prey by extending arms made of vines. Losing arms to predators does not trouble it.
flavorText.sword-shield: Tangrowth has two arms that it can extend as it pleases. Recent research has shown that these arms are, in fact, bundles of vines.
flavorText.legends-arceus: Draped with long vines, it resembles a shrub in appearance. It swings bundles of vines as though they were arms, wrapping them around prey to ensnare them.

flavorText.diamond-pearl: It pushes the tips of its two tails against the foe, then lets loose with over 20,000 volts of power.
flavorText.platinum: Heedless of enemy attacks, it closes in, shoves its tails onto the foe, then looses high voltage.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: As its electric charge amplifies, blue sparks begin to crackle between its horns.
flavorText.black-white: Heedless of enemy attacks, it closes in, shoves its tails onto the foe, then looses high voltage.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: The instant it presses the tips of its tails onto an opponent, it sends over 20,000 volts of electricity into the foe.
flavorText.x-y: As its electric charge amplifies, blue sparks begin to crackle between its horns.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: As its electric charge amplifies, blue sparks begin to crackle between its horns.
flavorText.sun-moon: It pushes the tips of its tails against its foes and then lets loose a high-voltage current. Its foes are burned to a crisp in an instant.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: It grips its tail, which spews electricity, and then beats down opponents with the power of its electrified fist.
flavorText.sword-shield: The amount of electrical energy this Pokémon produces is proportional to the rate of its pulse. The voltage jumps while Electivire is battling.
flavorText.legends-arceus: Its evolution was induced by an unusual item, and its electrical output rises along with its heart rate. From its tails, it can unleash an electric current measuring 20,000 volts.

flavorText.diamond-pearl: It blasts fireballs of over 3,600 degrees F from the ends of its arms. It lives in volcanic craters.
flavorText.platinum: When launching 3,600 degrees F fireballs, its body takes on a whitish hue from the intense heat.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: It blasts fireballs of over 3,600 degrees Fahrenheit out of its arms. Its breath also sears and sizzles.
flavorText.black-white: When launching 3,600 degrees F fireballs, its body takes on a whitish hue from the intense heat.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: When shooting 3,600 degree F fireballs from its arms, its body takes on a whitish hue from the intense heat.
flavorText.x-y: It blasts fireballs of over 3,600 degrees Fahrenheit from the ends of its arms. It lives in volcanic craters.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: It blasts fireballs of over 3,600 degrees Fahrenheit from the ends of its arms. It lives in volcanic craters.
flavorText.sun-moon: They dwell in volcanic craters. According to what is known, a single pair of male and female Magmortar lives in one volcano.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: There are still quite a few factories that rely on the flames provided by Magmortar to process metals.
flavorText.sword-shield: When Magmortar inhales deeply, the fire burning in its belly intensifies, rising in temperature to over 3,600 degrees Fahrenheit.
flavorText.legends-arceus: Use of a strange item caused this Pokémon to evolve. Fireballs launched from the ends of its tubelike arms are hot enough to melt an iron pot in an instant.

flavorText.diamond-pearl: It will never appear where there is strife. Its sightings have become rare recently.
flavorText.platinum: It shares many blessings with people who respect one another’s rights and avoid needless strife.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: As everyone knows, it visits peaceful regions, bringing them gifts of kindness and sweet blessings.
flavorText.black-white: It shares many blessings with people who respect one another’s rights and avoid needless strife.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: It shares many blessings with people who respect one another’s rights and avoid needless strife.
flavorText.x-y: As everyone knows, it visits peaceful regions, bringing them gifts of kindness and sweet blessings.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: As everyone knows, it visits peaceful regions, bringing them gifts of kindness and sweet blessings.
flavorText.sword-shield: These Pokémon are never seen anywhere near conflict or turmoil. In recent times, they’ve hardly been seen at all.
flavorText.legends-arceus: Scant few have ever sighted this Pokémon. After studying what literature remains, I am certain Togekiss will reveal itself when peace reigns in the land.

flavorText.diamond-pearl: By churning its wings, it creates shock waves that inflict critical internal injuries to foes.
flavorText.platinum: Its jaw power is incredible. It is adept at biting apart foes while flying by at high speed.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: This six-legged Pokémon is easily capable of transporting an adult in flight. The wings on its tail help it stay balanced.
flavorText.black-white: Its jaw power is incredible. It is adept at biting apart foes while flying by at high speed.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: It prefers to battle by biting apart foes’ heads instantly while flying by at high speed.
flavorText.x-y: It prefers to battle by biting apart foes’ heads instantly while flying by at high speed.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: It prefers to battle by biting apart foes’ heads instantly while flying by at high speed.
flavorText.legends-arceus: Extremely violent. When hunting, it wastes none of its energy, aiming only for prey's most vulnerable spots. Any who manage to tame this Pokémon must be of incredible bravery.

flavorText.diamond-pearl: Just like a plant, it uses photosynthesis. As a result, it is always enveloped in clear air.
flavorText.platinum: It basically does not fight. With cells similar to those of plants, it can perform photosynthesis.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: When you see LEAFEON asleep in a patch of sunshine, you’ll know it is using photosynthesis to produce clean air.
flavorText.black-white: It basically does not fight. With cells similar to those of plants, it can perform photosynthesis.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: With cells similar to those of plants, it performs photosynthesis inside its body and creates pure air.
flavorText.x-y: When you see Leafeon asleep in a patch of sunshine, you’ll know it is using photosynthesis to produce clean air.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: When you see Leafeon asleep in a patch of sunshine, you’ll know it is using photosynthesis to produce clean air.
flavorText.sun-moon: Its cellular composition is closer to that of a plant than an animal. It uses photosynthesis to produce its energy supply without eating food.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: Although it doesn’t like disputes, it will sharpen the leaf on its tail into a blade and fight if it has to protect its friends.
flavorText.sword-shield: Galarians favor the distinctive aroma that drifts from this Pokémon’s leaves. There’s a popular perfume made using that scent.
flavorText.legends-arceus: Cells similar to those of plants have been found in its fur. Its hard tail can fell a large tree with one stroke, and the tail's sharpness exceeds even that of a sword crafted by a master.

flavorText.diamond-pearl: As a protective technique, it can completely freeze its fur to make its hairs stand like needles.
flavorText.platinum: By controlling its body heat, it can freeze the atmosphere around it to make a diamond-dust flurry.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: It causes small ice crystals to form by lowering the temperature of the surrounding atmosphere.
flavorText.black-white: By controlling its body heat, it can freeze the atmosphere around it to make a diamond-dust flurry.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: It lowers its body heat to freeze its fur. The hairs then become like needles it can fire.
flavorText.x-y: By controlling its body heat, it can freeze the atmosphere around it to make a diamond-dust flurry.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: By controlling its body heat, it can freeze the atmosphere around it to make a diamond-dust flurry.
flavorText.sun-moon: It can control its body temperature at will. This enables it to freeze the moisture in the atmosphere, creating flurries of diamond dust.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: It protects itself by freezing its fur into sharp needles. It can drop its body temperature below –75 degrees Fahrenheit.
flavorText.sword-shield: Any who become captivated by the beauty of the snowfall that Glaceon creates will be frozen before they know it.
flavorText.legends-arceus: Glaceon is able to lower its body temperature very quickly. It freezes the atmosphere, creating diamond dust that glitters like gems while it flutters and dances around.

flavorText.diamond-pearl: It observes prey while hanging inverted from branches. When the chance presents itself, it swoops!
flavorText.platinum: If it succeeds in catching even a faint breeze properly, it can circle the globe without flapping once.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: Its flight is soundless. It uses its lengthy tail to carry off its prey... Then its elongated fangs do the rest.
flavorText.black-white: If it succeeds in catching even a faint breeze properly, it can circle the globe without flapping once.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: It dances silently through the sky. When it approaches prey, it can land a critical hit in an instant.
flavorText.x-y: It observes prey while hanging inverted from branches. When the chance presents itself, it swoops!
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: It observes prey while hanging inverted from branches. When the chance presents itself, it swoops!
flavorText.legends-arceus: It glides soundlessly on pitch-black wings and sinks sharp fangs into the throat of its prey. It takes on a look of satisfaction once it has entirely drained its prey of blood.

flavorText.diamond-pearl: Its impressive tusks are made of ice. The population thinned when it turned warm after the ice age.
flavorText.platinum: A frozen one was dug up from soil dating back 10,000 years. It woke up to much amazement.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: A frozen MAMOSWINE was dug from ice dating back 10,000 years. This Pokémon has been around a long, long, long time.
flavorText.black-white: A frozen one was dug up from soil dating back 10,000 years. It woke up to much amazement.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: When the temperature rose at the end of the ice age, most Mamoswine disappeared.
flavorText.x-y: A frozen Mamoswine was dug from ice dating back 10,000 years. This Pokémon has been around a long, long, long time.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: A frozen Mamoswine was dug from ice dating back 10,000 years. This Pokémon has been around a long, long, long time.
flavorText.sword-shield: This Pokémon can be spotted in wall paintings from as far back as 10,000 years ago. For a while, it was thought to have gone extinct.
flavorText.legends-arceus: This species reached its zenith during the period known as the ice age. I suspect that Hisui's frigid climate is in harmony with Mamoswine's constitution, thus awakening hidden potential.

flavorText.diamond-pearl: Additional software was installed to make it a better Pokémon. It began acting oddly, however.
flavorText.platinum: Its programming was modified to enable work in alien dimensions. It did not work as planned.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: Its programming was modified to enable it to travel through alien dimensions. Seems there might have been an error...
flavorText.black-white: Its programming was modified to enable work in alien dimensions. It did not work as planned.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: Its programming was modified to enable work in alien dimensions. It did not work as planned.
flavorText.x-y: Additional software was installed to make it a better Pokémon. It began acting oddly, however.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Additional software was installed to make it a better Pokémon. It began acting oddly, however.
flavorText.sun-moon: In order to create a more advanced Pokémon, an additional program was installed, but apparently it contained a defect that makes it move oddly.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: Its behavior is noticeably unstable, which is apparently due to the incompetence of the engineer who updated its programming.
flavorText.sword-shield: Porygon-Z had a program installed to allow it to move between dimensions, but the program also caused instability in Porygon-Z’s behavior.
flavorText.legends-arceus: A curious item induced this evolution. The Pokémon's offensive capabilities have greatly increased, but the strangeness of its behavior has magnified in equal measure. This worries me.

flavorText.x-y: A master of courtesy and swordsmanship, it fights using extending swords on its elbows.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: A master of courtesy and swordsmanship, it fights using extending swords on its elbows.
flavorText.platinum: When trying to protect someone, it extends its elbows as if they were swords and fights savagely.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: Because it can sense what its foe is thinking, its attacks burst out first, fast, and fierce.
flavorText.black-white: When trying to protect someone, it extends its elbows as if they were swords and fights savagely.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: When trying to protect someone, it extends its elbows as if they were swords and fights savagely.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Because it can sense what its foe is thinking, its attacks burst out first, fast, and fierce.
flavorText.sword-shield: True to its honorable-warrior image, it uses the blades on its elbows only in defense of something or someone.
flavorText.legends-arceus: The blades extending from its elbows are sharper than the finest swords. Its swordsmanship, albeit self-taught, is astonishingly impressive.

flavorText.black-2-white-2: It freely controls three units called Mini-Noses using magnetic force.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: It exudes strong magnetism from all over. It controls three small units called Mini-Noses.
flavorText.platinum: It freely controls three small units called Mini-Noses using magnetic force.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: It controls three units called Mini-Noses using magnetic force. With them, it can attack the foe from three directions.
flavorText.black-white: It freely controls three small units called Mini-Noses using magnetic force.
flavorText.x-y: It exudes strong magnetism from all over. It controls three small units called Mini-Noses.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: It exudes strong magnetism from all over. It controls three small units called Mini-Noses.
flavorText.sun-moon: It radiates such a powerful magnetic field that nearby electrical appliances become unusable.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: Although it can control its units known as Mini-Noses, they sometimes get lost and don’t come back.
flavorText.legends-arceus: It is able to emit powerful magnetism, allowing it control over the iron sand that forms its luscious mustache. Using this iron sand, Probopass forms hard stones with which it smites its prey.

flavorText.diamond-pearl: The antenna on its head captures radio waves from the world of spirits that command it to take people there.
flavorText.platinum: It is said to take lost spirits into its pliant body and guide them home.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: This feared Pokémon is said to travel to worlds unknown. Some even believe that it takes lost spirits along with it.
flavorText.black-white: It is said to take lost spirits into its pliant body and guide them home.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: It is said to take lost spirits into its pliant body and guide them home.
flavorText.x-y: It is said to take lost spirits into its pliant body and guide them home.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: It is said to take lost spirits into its pliant body and guide them home.
flavorText.sword-shield: At the bidding of transmissions from the spirit world, it steals people and Pokémon away. No one knows whether it has a will of its own.
flavorText.legends-arceus: Comes to those whose lives have come to an end and escorts their souls to the afterlife. Known to mistakenly take the souls of those who yet have life left in them, albeit rarely.

flavorText.diamond-pearl: It freezes foes with an icy breath nearly -60 degrees F. What seems to be its body is actually hollow.
flavorText.platinum: It freezes prey by blowing its -58 degrees F breath. It is said to then secretly display its prey.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: Legends in snowy regions say that a woman who was lost on an icy mountain was reborn as FROSLASS.
flavorText.black-white: It freezes prey by blowing its -58 degrees F breath. It is said to then secretly display its prey.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: It freezes prey by blowing its -58 degrees F breath. It is said to then secretly display its prey.
flavorText.x-y: It freezes foes with an icy breath nearly -60 degrees Fahrenheit. What seems to be its body is actually hollow.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: It freezes foes with an icy breath nearly -60 degrees Fahrenheit. What seems to be its body is actually hollow.
flavorText.sun-moon: When it finds humans or Pokémon it likes, it freezes them and takes them to its chilly den, where they become decorations.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: It freezes hikers who have come to climb snowy mountains and carries them back to its home. It only goes after men it thinks are handsome.
flavorText.sword-shield: After a woman met her end on a snowy mountain, her regrets lingered on. From them, this Pokémon was born. Its favorite food is frozen souls.
flavorText.legends-arceus: A Pokémon inhabited by the soul of a woman who died bearing a grudge in the snowy mountains. Legends of Froslass placing deathly curses on misbehaving men send shivers down my spine.

flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Research continues on this Pokémon, which could be the power source of a unique motor.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: Its body is composed of plasma. It is known to infiltrate electronic devices and wreak havoc.
flavorText.platinum: Its electric-like body can enter some kinds of machines and take control in order to make mischief.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: Research continues on this Pokémon, which could be the power source of a unique motor.
flavorText.black-white: Its electric-like body can enter some kinds of machines and take control in order to make mischief.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: Its electric-like body can enter some kinds of machines and take control in order to make mischief.
flavorText.x-y: Research continues on this Pokémon, which could be the power source of a unique motor.
flavorText.sword-shield: One boy’s invention led to the development of many different machines that take advantage of Rotom’s unique capabilities.
flavorText.legends-arceus: This bizarre Pokémon appears to be a will-o'-the-wisp powered by electricity. Be wary, as Rotom is both smart and mischievous.

flavorText.diamond-pearl: Known as “The Being of Knowledge.” It is said that it can wipe out the memory of those who see its eyes.
flavorText.platinum: When UXIE flew, people gained the ability to solve problems. It was the birth of knowledge.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: According to some sources, this Pokémon provided people with the intelligence necessary to solve various problems.
flavorText.black-white: When Uxie flew, people gained the ability to solve problems. It was the birth of knowledge.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: When Uxie flew, people gained the ability to solve problems. It was the birth of knowledge.
flavorText.x-y: Known as “The Being of Knowledge.” It is said that it can wipe out the memory of those who see its eyes.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Known as “The Being of Knowledge.” It is said that it can wipe out the memory of those who see its eyes.
flavorText.legends-arceus: A Pokémon feared but also respected for stealing away the memories of evildoers. I have found records that suggest Uxie holds dominion over knowledge.

flavorText.diamond-pearl: Known as “The Being of Emotion.” It taught humans the nobility of sorrow, pain, and joy.
flavorText.platinum: When MESPRIT flew, people learned the joy and sadness of living. It was the birth of emotions.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: This Pokémon is said to have endowed the human heart with emotions, such as sorrow and joy.
flavorText.black-white: When Mesprit flew, people learned the joy and sadness of living. It was the birth of emotions.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: When Mesprit flew, people learned the joy and sadness of living. It was the birth of emotions.
flavorText.x-y: Known as “The Being of Emotion.” It taught humans the nobility of sorrow, pain, and joy.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Known as “The Being of Emotion.” It taught humans the nobility of sorrow, pain, and joy.
flavorText.legends-arceus: Known as the Being of Emotion. In legend, this Pokémon was feared, as any who showed disrespect would have their emotions thrown into disarray.

flavorText.x-y: It is thought that Uxie, Mesprit, and Azelf all came from the same egg.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: Known as “The Being of Willpower.” It sleeps at the bottom of a lake to keep the world in balance.
flavorText.platinum: When AZELF flew, people gained the determination to do things. It was the birth of willpower.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: This Pokémon is said to have endowed humans with the determination needed to face any of life’s difficulties.
flavorText.black-white: When Azelf flew, people gained the determination to do things. It was the birth of willpower.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: When Azelf flew, people gained the determination to do things. It was the birth of willpower.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Known as “The Being of Willpower.” It sleeps at the bottom of a lake to keep the world in balance.
flavorText.legends-arceus: The dreaded Being of Willpower. Legends tell of this Pokémon manipulating the will of its adversaries and turning them into puppets of its own.

flavorText.diamond-pearl: It has the power to control time. It appears in Sinnoh-region myths as an ancient deity.
flavorText.platinum: A legendary Pokémon of Sinnoh. It is said that time flows when DIALGA’s heart beats.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: This Pokémon completely controls the flow of time. It uses its power to travel at will through the past and future.
flavorText.black-white: A legendary Pokémon of Sinnoh. It is said that time flows when Dialga’s heart beats.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: A legendary Pokémon of Sinnoh. It is said that time flows when Dialga’s heart beats.
flavorText.x-y: A Pokémon spoken of in legend. It is said that time began moving when Dialga was born.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: A Pokémon spoken of in legend. It is said that time began moving when Dialga was born.
flavorText.legends-arceus: This Pokémon is revered as a deity in Hisuian legend. The birth of Dialga was what caused the vast river of time to begin flowing in our world.

flavorText.diamond-pearl: It has the ability to distort space. It is described as a deity in Sinnoh-region mythology.
flavorText.platinum: A legendary Pokémon of Sinnoh. It is said that space becomes more stable with PALKIA’s every breath.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: Its total control over the boundaries of space enable it to transport itself to faraway places or even other dimensions.
flavorText.black-white: A legendary Pokémon of Sinnoh. It is said that space becomes more stable with Palkia’s every breath.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: A legendary Pokémon of Sinnoh. It is said that space becomes more stable with Palkia’s every breath.
flavorText.x-y: It is said to live in a gap in the spatial dimension parallel to ours. It appears in mythology.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: It is said to live in a gap in the spatial dimension parallel to ours. It appears in mythology.
flavorText.legends-arceus: This Pokémon is feared as a deity in Hisuian legend. The birth of Palkia was what caused the walls of our world to disappear, creating a sky that spans for infinity.

flavorText.diamond-pearl: It dwells in volcanic caves. It digs in with its cross-shaped feet to crawl on ceilings and walls.
flavorText.platinum: Its body is made of rugged steel. However, it is partially melted in spots because of its own heat.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: Boiling blood, like magma, circulates through its body. It makes its dwelling place in volcanic caves.
flavorText.black-white: Its body is made of rugged steel. However, it is partially melted in spots because of its own heat.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: Its body is made of rugged steel. However, it is partially melted in spots because of its own heat.
flavorText.x-y: It dwells in volcanic caves. It digs in with its cross-shaped feet to crawl on ceilings and walls.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: It dwells in volcanic caves. It digs in with its cross-shaped feet to crawl on ceilings and walls.
flavorText.legends-arceus: Stories tell of this Pokémon being birthed from the boiling magma within Mount Coronet. Its molten-steel body holds many mysteries.

flavorText.diamond-pearl: There is an enduring legend that states this Pokémon towed continents with ropes.
flavorText.platinum: It is said to have made Pokémon that look like itself from a special ice mountain, rocks, and magma.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: It is believed to have shaped REGIROCK, REGICE, and REGISTEEL out of clay, ice, and magma.
flavorText.black-white: It is said to have made Pokémon that look like itself from a special ice mountain, rocks, and magma.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: It is said to have made Pokémon that look like itself from a special ice mountain, rocks, and magma.
flavorText.x-y: It is said to have made Pokémon that look like itself from a special ice mountain, rocks, and magma.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: It is said to have made Pokémon that look like itself from a special ice mountain, rocks, and magma.
flavorText.sword-shield: All over the world, there are legends that tell of Regigigas creating other Pokémon in its own image.
flavorText.legends-arceus: According to legend, Regigigas pulled landmasses together and bound them with rope to create the continent of Hisui. Though I have my doubts, the story could well contain a shred of truth.

flavorText.diamond-pearl: A Pokémon that is said to live in a world on the reverse side of ours. It appears in an ancient cemetery.
flavorText.platinum: It was banished for its violence. It silently gazed upon the old world from the Distortion World.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: This Pokémon is said to live in a world on the reverse side of ours, where common knowledge is distorted and strange.
flavorText.black-white: It was banished for its violence. It silently gazed upon the old world from the Distortion World.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: It was banished for its violence. It silently gazed upon the old world from the Distortion World.
flavorText.x-y: This Pokémon is said to live in a world on the reverse side of ours, where common knowledge is distorted and strange.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: This Pokémon is said to live in a world on the reverse side of ours, where common knowledge is distorted and strange.
flavorText.legends-arceus: There is one Hisuian verse that tells of a powerful light creating a deep shadow. I imagine that this deep shadow is Giratina.

flavorText.diamond-pearl: Shiny particles are released from its wings like a veil. It is said to represent the crescent moon.
flavorText.platinum: On nights around the quarter moon, the aurora from its tail extends and undulates beautifully.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: Those who sleep holding CRESSELIA’s feather are assured of joyful dreams. It is said to represent the crescent moon.
flavorText.black-white: On nights around the quarter moon, the aurora from its tail extends and undulates beautifully.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: On nights around the quarter moon, the aurora from its tail extends and undulates beautifully.
flavorText.x-y: Shiny particles are released from its wings like a veil. It is said to represent the crescent moon.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Shiny particles are released from its wings like a veil. It is said to represent the crescent moon.
flavorText.legends-arceus: Cresselia is reminiscent of the crescent moon. It leaves a brilliant line of light in its wake as it flies across the night sky. I daresay it resembles the heavenly maiden who created the Milky Way.

flavorText.diamond-pearl: A Pokémon that lives in warm seas. It inflates the flotation sac on its head to drift and search for food.
flavorText.platinum: It drifts in warm seas. It always returns to where it was born, no matter how far it may have drifted.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: When the water warms, they inflate the flotation sac on their heads and drift languidly on the sea in packs.
flavorText.black-white: It drifts in warm seas. It always returns to where it was born, no matter how far it may have drifted.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: It drifts in warm seas. It always returns to where it was born, no matter how far it may have drifted.
flavorText.x-y: When the water warms, they inflate the flotation sac on their heads and drift languidly on the sea in packs.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: When the water warms, they inflate the flotation sac on their heads and drift languidly on the sea in packs.
flavorText.legends-arceus: Can be seen floating offshore during seasons when the seas are warm. Its azure body blends in with the ocean waters—logic suggests this is a defense mechanism against natural predators.

flavorText.diamond-pearl: Born on a cold seafloor, it will swim great distances to return to its birthplace.
flavorText.platinum: It is born with a wondrous power that lets it bond with any kind of Pokémon.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: It starts its life with a wondrous power that permits it to bond with any kind of Pokémon.
flavorText.black-white: It is born with a wondrous power that lets it bond with any kind of Pokémon.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: It is born with a wondrous power that lets it bond with any kind of Pokémon.
flavorText.x-y: It is born with a wondrous power that lets it bond with any kind of Pokémon.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: It is born with a wondrous power that lets it bond with any kind of Pokémon.
flavorText.legends-arceus: Rumored to migrate across the oceans and visit Hisui's coastal waters only rarely. Although Manaphy resembles Phione, it is also quite different. The relation between the two is unclear.

flavorText.diamond-pearl: It can lull people to sleep and make them dream. It is active during nights of the new moon.
flavorText.platinum: To protect itself, it afflicts those around it with nightmares. However, it means no harm.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: It chases people and Pokémon from its territory by causing them to experience deep, nightmarish slumbers.
flavorText.black-white: To protect itself, it afflicts those around it with nightmares. However, it means no harm.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: To protect itself, it afflicts those around it with nightmares. However, it means no harm.
flavorText.x-y: It chases people and Pokémon from its territory by causing them to experience deep, nightmarish slumbers.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: It chases people and Pokémon from its territory by causing them to experience deep, nightmarish slumbers.
flavorText.legends-arceus: On a moonless night, a strange incident occurred in which every one of a village's inhabitants suffered nightmares. The villagers attested that Darkrai appeared before them in these nightmares.

flavorText.diamond-pearl: It lives in flower patches and avoids detection by curling up to look like a flowering plant.
flavorText.platinum: The flowers all over its body burst into bloom if it is lovingly hugged and senses gratitude.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: The blooming of Gracidea flowers confers the power of flight upon it. Feelings of gratitude are the message it delivers.
flavorText.black-white: The flowers all over its body burst into bloom if it is lovingly hugged and senses gratitude.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: The flowers all over its body burst into bloom if it is lovingly hugged and senses gratitude.
flavorText.x-y: It can dissolve toxins in the air to instantly transform ruined land into a lush field of flowers.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: It can dissolve toxins in the air to instantly transform ruined land into a lush field of flowers.
flavorText.legends-arceus: When the turning of seasons brings the cruel winter to its end and the joyous people give thanks to the heavens, Shaymin appears and covers the withered land with flowers.

flavorText.platinum: It is said to have emerged from an egg in a place where there was nothing, then shaped the world.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: It is described in mythology as the Pokémon that shaped the universe with its 1,000 arms.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: According to the legends of Sinnoh, this Pokémon emerged from an egg and shaped all there is in this world.
flavorText.black-white: It is said to have emerged from an egg in a place where there was nothing, then shaped the world.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: It is said to have emerged from an egg in a place where there was nothing then shaped the world.
flavorText.x-y: According to the legends of Sinnoh, this Pokémon emerged from an egg and shaped all there is in this world.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: According to the legends of Sinnoh, this Pokémon emerged from an egg and shaped all there is in this world.
flavorText.legends-arceus: It is the heavenly fount from which pours the light that shines across Hisui. Its luminance guides and protects all Pokémon. Hisuian mythology states that Arceus is the creator of all things.
